Authors: Yuxuan Hu, Shilin Shan, Qiheng Wang, Jinghan Yang, Junqiao Fan, Hao Wan, Jianfei Yang

BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body tracking terrain adaptation force exertion flow matching DAgger

简要说明：BRACE 是一种人形机器人全身跟踪控制器，通过变换参考运动，将平地、无负载的参考动作适应到斜坡地形和指令手部力，并通过 DAgger 将施力和补偿行为蒸馏为仅基于本体感觉的策略。

TLDR: BRACE is a whole-body tracking controller for humanoid robots that adapts flat-ground, no-load reference motions to sloped terrain and commanded hand forces by transforming the reference motion, and distills force-exertion and compensation behaviors into a proprioception-only policy via DAgger.

Abstract: Whole-body tracking has become the interface through which operators drive humanoid robots, yet the references it consumes are recorded on level ground and carrying nothing, so the tracker is aware of neither the forces the robot must exchange with objects nor the terrain it must stand on. Existing controllers address one side of this gap: force-capable policies command an end-effector force but prescribe no whole-body pose, while terrain-adaptive trackers treat loads as disturbances to reject rather than wrenches to command. We present BRACE, a whole-body tracker that exerts and compensates commanded hand forces from diverse poses while following a flat-ground reference on sloped terrain. Rather than leaving the tracker to absorb the load and the slope, BRACE folds both into the reference it follows: terrain conformance lifts footholds and root onto the local surface, and a wrench transformation resolves the hand displacement that produces a force jointly with the center-of-mass and center- of-pressure shifts it induces, bounded by teacher-specific arm-effort limits. Separate exertion and compensation teachers are distilled by DAgger into one flow-matching student that runs on proprioception alone, without a height map or measured wrench, so a teleoperator (even in remote locations) can supply a flat- ground trajectory and the robot resolves slope and load onboard. We extensive experiments on the Unitree-G1 to demonstrate the ability of BRACE to exert, compensate force and handle diverse terrain in simulation and real robot experiments.

摘要（中文）：全身跟踪已成为操作员驱动机器人的人形机器人的接口，然而其消耗的参考轨迹是在平坦地面上且未携带任何负载的情况下记录的，因此跟踪器既不知道机器人必须与物体交换的力，也不知道其必须站立的地形。现有控制器仅解决了这一差距的一个方面：具备力控制能力的策略命令末端执行器施加特定力，但未规定全身姿态；而地形自适应跟踪器则将负载视为需要抑制的干扰，而非需要指令的力旋量。我们提出了BRACE，一种全身跟踪器，能够在斜坡地形上跟随平面参考轨迹的同时，从多种姿态施加并补偿指令手部力。BRACE并未让跟踪器自行吸收负载和坡度的影响，而是将两者纳入其跟随的参考轨迹中：地形贴合将立足点和根部抬升至局部表面，力旋量变换则解算出手部位移，该位移与引起的质心和压力中心偏移共同产生力，并以教师特定的手臂出力极限为约束。独立的施力与补偿教师通过DAgger算法被蒸馏为一个仅依赖本体感觉的流匹配学生模型，无需高度图或实测力旋量，因此遥操作员（即使在远程位置）可以提供平面轨迹，机器人则自行在机载解决坡度和负载问题。我们在Unitree-G1上进行了大量实验，以证明BRACE在仿真和真实机器人实验中施加力、补偿力以及应对多样地形的能力。

Authors: Sudarshan Harithas, Chen Yu, Juan Borbon, Shubhankar Mondal, Winston Zha, Srinath Sridhar, Dingqi Zhang, Jiuguang Wang

Dataset-Free Compliant Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Dynamic Online Posture Locomotion

loco-manipulation whole-body compliance online posture generation reachability prior humanoid robot

简要说明：OCLO 提出了一种无需人类运动数据的人形机器人全身操控控制器，通过在线姿态生成和柔顺训练，在 Unitree G1 上实现了多样任务，并在扰动下保持平衡。

TLDR: OCLO presents a dataset-free humanoid loco-manipulation controller that uses online posture generation and compliance training to achieve diverse tasks on a Unitree G1, improving success rates and balance under disturbances.

Abstract: Most humanoid loco-manipulation controllers require human motion data to learn whole-body coordination and posture, leaving policies reliant on external sources to provide this data. We present OCLO (Online-posture Compliant LOco-manipulation), a humanoid loco-manipulation system trained without human motion data and commanded only through two end-effector targets. Because these targets do not uniquely determine whole-body posture, OCLO generates pelvis height and torso orientation online using an analytic reachability prior, further refined through policy-in-the-loop sampling with a task-agnostic cost. OCLO also learns whole-body compliance by displacing end-effector references according to measured forces through a spring-damper model, encouraging the legs, waist, and pelvis to yield to external loads. In simulation, using the reachability prior leads to a 77.8% success rate in acquiring the commanded reference, a vast improvement over the 37.8% success rate accomplished without the prior. Further, refinement reduces end-effector orientation error across all evaluated tasks. The same posture module improves a pretrained SONIC controller on four of five tasks. Without compliance training, policies tend to lose balance under disturbances rather than sacrifice tracking. On a Unitree G1, OCLO maintains balance under end-effector disturbances that cause its ablations to fail and performs seven loco-manipulation tasks, including crouched walking and picking up a box from a low surface. Project website: https://oclo-humanoid.github.io/

摘要（中文）：大多数现有的人形机器人移动操控控制器依赖于人体运动数据来学习全身协调与姿态，从而使策略依赖外部数据源提供这些信息。我们提出OCLO（在线姿态顺应性移动操控），一种无需人体运动数据、仅通过两个末端执行器目标即可指令控制的人形机器人移动操控系统。由于这些目标无法唯一确定全身姿态，OCLO利用解析可达性先验在线生成骨盆高度和躯干姿态，并通过基于策略的回环采样与任务无关代价进一步优化。OCLO还通过学习全身顺应性，依据弹簧-阻尼模型根据实测力位移末端执行器参考，促使腿部、腰部和骨盆在外部载荷下顺应屈服。在仿真中，使用可达性先验使命令参考获取的成功率达到77.8%，远优于无先验时的37.8%。此外，优化过程在所有评估任务中均降低了末端执行器方向误差。相同的姿态模块在五项任务中的四项上提升了预训练的SONIC控制器性能。未经顺应性训练的策略在面对扰动时倾向于失去平衡，而非牺牲跟踪精度。在Unitree G1上，OCLO在导致其消融变体失败的末端执行器扰动下保持平衡，并执行了七项移动操控任务，包括蹲姿行走和从低矮表面拾取箱子。项目网站：https://oclo-humanoid.github.io/

Authors: Seungho Yeom, Zhenyu Wu, Jaeyoung Huh, Diego Williams, Yuheng Zhi, Soofiyan Atar, Michael Yip

Wiring Matters: Injection Topology and Initialization of Affordance Heads in Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

affordance head VLA policy injection topology initialization LIBERO benchmark

简要说明：本文研究如何将affordance头接入VLA策略，发现使用停止梯度和主动初始化的残差桥接可在LIBERO上以极少参数开销媲美更复杂的三专家模型。

TLDR: This paper studies how to wire affordance heads into VLA policies, finding that a stop-gradient and actively-initialized residual bridge matches a more elaborate three-expert model on LIBERO with minimal parameter overhead.

Abstract: Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how to wire such a head into a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops the policy below the headless base (85.5% vs. 93.1%). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2*2 ablation over injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2%, matching the far more elaborate three-expert AffordanceVLA (95.8%) with under 1% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes load-bearing.

摘要（中文）：密集的可供性监督是视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中一种有吸引力的辅助信号，然而，简单地对可供性预测头进行联合训练可能会严重损害指令跟随能力。我们在LIBERO基准上对如何将这种预测头接入现代VLA进行了受控研究。我们的方案通过停止梯度读取主干网络，并通过学习得到的桥接模块将中间层预测头特征重新注入动作专家网络。停止梯度是一个前提条件：若允许可供性梯度传播至主干网络，策略性能将降至无预测头基线之下（85.5%对93.1%）。在保护主干网络的前提下，针对注入拓扑结构（拼接对残差）和桥接初始化方式（零初始化对随机初始化）进行了同等预算的2×2消融实验，结果表明初始化方式是主导因素。最优布线方案采用主动初始化的残差桥接，达到了96.2%的性能，与构造复杂得多的三专家AffordanceVLA（95.8%）相当，而额外参数不足1%。两项探针实验解释了其内在机制：将真实可供性作为输入会损害性能；推理时置零实验表明，惰性桥接仅充当训练时的正则化器，而主动桥接则成为承载性能的关键组件。

Authors: Zijian An, Linhan Wang, Jiayan Wang, Shijie Geng, Ran Yang, Yiming Feng, Lifeng Zhou

Artemis: Geometry-Grounded Multi-Agent Driving World Models with Shared 3D State and Progressive Memory Update WorldModel

multi-agent world model geometry-grounded shared 3D state progressive memory update driving simulation

简要说明：Artemis提出了一种基于几何约束的多智能体驾驶世界模型，通过显式共享3D状态和渐进式记忆更新，提高多视角一致性并处理动态背景。

TLDR: Artemis proposes a geometry-grounded multi-agent driving world model with explicit 3D state sharing and progressive memory updates to improve cross-view consistency and handle dynamic backgrounds in multi-agent driving simulations.

Abstract: Recent video world models have witnessed the paradigm shift from single-agent to multi-agent involvements, which can reveal more complicated dynamics and cross-agent interaction in the real world. However, existing approaches commonly adopt implicit inter-agent communications via cross attention, which lack explicit geometry constraints and unified 3D state, thereby leading to poor multi-view consistency and struggling with recovering out-of-sight agents. In addition, most of them assume a static background, failing to represent uncontrolled background dynamics. To address these problems, we propose Artemis: a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with explicit memory sharing. An explicit 3D world map is reconstructed from multi-agent observations to enforce a unified 3D state across agents, offering high cross-view consistency. Specifically, an action-guided geometric injection module is developed to simultaneously render decomposed foreground-background control maps, which are then injected into a diffusion transformer through a designed GeoAdapter block. Compared to previous methods assuming static-only background, our GeoAdapter can also distinguish uncontrolled non-agent dynamics, which are conditioned on their own multi-frame history positions to provide consistent motion cues. Keyframes selected from progressive video rollouts are used to progressively update the reconstructed 3D world maps. To effectively capture complex dynamic patterns, we curate a novel dataset sampled from the CARLA simulator called MA-CARLA. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in terms of visual fidelity and cross-view consistency in the generated videos. In addition, our Artemis can support simultaneous multi-modal rollouts with both 2D video and 3D point map maintenance, scale to scenarios beyond two agents and multi-camera setting.

摘要（中文）：近期视频世界模型经历了从单智能体到多智能体参与的范式转变，这种转变能够揭示现实世界中更复杂的动态特性及智能体间的交互。然而，现有方法通常采用通过交叉注意力实现的隐式智能体间通信，缺乏显式几何约束和统一的三维状态，导致多视角一致性较差，并且难以恢复视野之外的智能体。此外，大多数方法假设背景静态不变，无法表示不受控制的背景动态。为解决上述问题，我们提出Artemis：一种基于几何约束且具备显式记忆共享的多智能体世界模型。该模型从多智能体观测中重建显式三维世界地图，以在不同智能体之间强制执行统一的三维状态，从而实现高跨视角一致性。具体而言，我们开发了动作引导的几何注入模块，可同时渲染分解的前景-背景控制图，并通过设计的GeoAdapter模块将其注入扩散Transformer中。与以往仅假设静态背景的方法相比，我们的GeoAdapter还能区分不受控制的非智能体动态，这些动态以其各自的多帧历史位置为条件，以提供一致的运动线索。从渐进式视频生成中选取的关键帧被用于逐步更新重建的三维世界地图。为有效捕捉复杂动态模式，我们构建了一个从CARLA模拟器中采样的新型数据集，称为MA-CARLA。大量实验证明，我们提出的方法在生成视频的视觉保真度和跨视角一致性方面具有优越性。此外，我们的Artemis能够支持同时进行多模态生成，同时维护二维视频和三维点图，并可扩展到两个以上智能体及多摄像头的场景。

Authors: Sitian Shen, Jiuming Liu, Mengmeng Liu, Yian Wang, Michael Ying Yang, Francesco Nex, Hao Cheng, Daniele De Martini, Ayush Tewari, Per Ola Kristensson

When Does Retrieval Help? A Study of In-Context Adaptation in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

in-context adaptation retrieval vision-language-action model test-time adaptation

简要说明：本文系统研究了不同检索方法对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型下游任务性能的影响，发现没有一致最优的方法，且随机检索仍能取得不可忽略的成功率。

TLDR: This paper systematically studies how different retrieval methods affect downstream task performance in vision-language-action (VLA) models, finding no consistent winner and that random retrieval still achieves non-trivial success.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential as generalist robot policies, but adapting them to unseen tasks often requires costly parameter updates. Recent work such as RICL introduces in-context adaptability by retrieving expert demonstrations based on the current VLA observation and providing them as additional context at test time. The effectiveness of this adaptation therefore depends critically on the retrieval mechanism. In this work, we systematically study how different retrieval methods affect both retrieval quality and task performance within the RICL framework. Specifically, we compare four different methods: image-based retrieval, retrieval augmented with VLA's state, retrieval using features from the VLA backbone, and random retrieval. Our experiments yield three main findings. First, no retrieval method consistently dominates the others in task success, while surprisingly, random retrieval achieves a non-trivial success rate. Second, standard retrieval-quality diagnostics do not reliably reflect downstream VLA performance. Third, demonstrations from different but related tasks can provide useful transferable information. Together, these results provide an initial step toward understanding how retrieval mechanisms shape the in-context learning capability of VLA models and their downstream task performance, while highlighting the need for more careful design and evaluation of retrieval mechanisms for reliable test-time adaptation.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型展现出作为通用机器人策略的巨大潜力，但将其适应于未见任务往往需要昂贵的参数更新。近期研究如RICL通过基于当前VLA观测检索专家示范，并在测试时将其作为额外上下文提供，引入了上下文学习式的适应性。因此，这种适配的有效性在很大程度上取决于检索机制。在本研究中，我们系统地探讨了不同检索方法如何影响RICL框架内的检索质量与任务性能。具体而言，我们比较了四种不同方法：基于图像的检索、结合VLA状态的检索增强、使用VLA骨干网络特征的检索，以及随机检索。我们的实验得出三个主要发现。第一，没有任何一种检索方法在任务成功率上始终优于其他方法，而令人意外的是，随机检索也能达到非平凡的成功率。第二，标准的检索质量诊断指标并不能可靠地反映下游VLA性能。第三，来自不同但相关任务的示范能够提供有用的可迁移信息。综合来看，这些结果为进一步理解检索机制如何塑造VLA模型的上下文学习能力及其下游任务性能迈出了初步一步，同时强调了对检索机制进行更审慎的设计与评估以实现可靠的测试时适配的必要性。

Authors: Zixuan Liu, Joris Köster, Zizhan Zheng, Siavash Khajavi

R2RI: A Multi-View Event and RGB Dataset for Robot-to-Robot Interaction Other

robot-robot interaction multi-view dataset event cameras egocentric/exocentric humanoid robots

简要说明：R2RI 提出了首个面向机器人间交互的多视角事件与RGB数据集，包含自我中心和外部中心视角，并评估了现有方法。

TLDR: R2RI introduces the first large-scale multi-view Event and RGB dataset for robot-to-robot interaction, featuring egocentric and exocentric viewpoints and benchmarking state-of-the-art methods.

Abstract: Understanding and modeling interactions between autonomous agents is a fundamental challenge in robotics, with broad implications for collaborative systems, social robotics, and human-robot coexistence. Although the study of robot interactions has emerged as a compelling research direction, progress has been severely hampered by the absence of large-scale benchmarks. In this paper, we introduce Robot-to-Robot Interaction (R2RI), the first dataset specifically designed to address the Robot-Robot Interaction (RRI) task. R2RI consists of different humanoid robots and realistic interactions modeled on real human social behaviors. Complementary viewpoints are available, \textit{i.e.}, an egocentric perspective from each robot's onboard sensors, and an exocentric perspective from external fixed cameras, thus enabling rich spatial and contextual understanding of the interaction dynamics. The dataset comprises more than $6.5$M frames and $\approx5000$ videos at $120$ fps, including Event and RGB domains. We investigate pros and cons of each domain, comparing state-of-the-art approaches for a number of key sensing and interaction based tasks. We publicly release the dataset and its annotations for all tasks and modalities at https://github.com/MagriniGabriele/R2RI.

摘要（中文）：理解并建模自主智能体之间的交互是机器人学中的一项基本挑战，对协作系统、社交机器人以及人机共存具有广泛影响。尽管机器人交互研究已成为一个引人关注的研究方向，但缺乏大规模基准数据集严重制约了其进展。在本文中，我们提出了机器人间交互（R2RI）数据集，这是首个专门针对机器人-机器人交互（RRI）任务设计的数据集。R2RI包含多种类人机器人，以及基于真实人类社交行为建模的逼真交互场景。数据集提供互补视角，即每台机器人机载传感器采集的自我中心视角和外部固定相机采集的外部中心视角，从而能够对交互动态进行丰富的空间和上下文理解。该数据集包含超过650万帧图像和约5000个视频，帧率为120帧/秒，涵盖事件域和RGB域。我们探讨了每个域的优势与不足，并比较了多种关键感知和基于交互任务的最先进方法。我们公开发布了该数据集及其所有任务和模态的标注，网址为https://github.com/MagriniGabriele/R2RI。

Authors: Gabriele Magrini, Riccardo Catalini, Federico Becattini, Guido Borghi, Pietro Pala, Roberto Vezzani, Lorenzo Seidenari

AIM: Adaptive Interaction Modeling Networks for Real-to-Sim Soft-Body Simulation Manipulation

soft-body simulation adaptive interaction modeling deformable-object manipulation real-to-sim kinematic control-point

简要说明：AIM 提出了一种自适应交互建模框架，用于真实到模拟的软体仿真，提高了变形预测的准确性，并支持跨操作、物体实例和场景的泛化，包括零样本迁移到人类操作。

TLDR: AIM introduces an adaptive interaction modeling framework for real-to-sim soft-body simulation, improving deformation prediction and generalizing across manipulation actions, object instances, and scenes, including zero-shot transfer to human manipulation.

Abstract: Deformable-object manipulation is essential for robotic tasks such as folding laundry and handling food, where robots must control shape changes as well as object motion. Predictive soft-body simulation supports these tasks by anticipating deformation under external interactions. However, spatial neighborhoods can misrepresent deformation dependencies, introducing local errors that accumulate over successive predictions. Models fitted to individual scenes must also accommodate changes in object geometry and manipulation conditions. In this work, we propose AIM, an Adaptive Interaction Modeling framework that treats real-to-sim soft-body simulation as a local-global interaction modeling problem. AIM uses motion history and geometry to adapt particle relations over current spatial neighbors and retained connections, while geometry-conditioned global communication coordinates object-wide responses. A unified kinematic control-point interface represents different manipulation configurations, and multi-step autoregressive supervision trains the model on its own predicted trajectories. Experiments on PhysTwin and PGND demonstrate improved motion accuracy and visual fidelity, with a 20.0% reduction in future-prediction tracking error relative to PhysTwin and a 22.8% reduction in mean long-horizon particle error across six object categories relative to PGND. The framework further supports transfer across actions, object instances, and scenes, including zero-shot transfer from robot interactions to human manipulation without target-domain dynamics fitting.

摘要（中文）：可变形物体操作对于折叠衣物、处理食品等机器人任务至关重要，在这些任务中，机器人必须同时控制形状变化和物体运动。预测性软体仿真通过预判外部交互下的形变来支持这些任务。然而，空间邻域可能无法准确表征形变依赖关系，从而导致局部误差在连续预测中不断累积。针对单个场景拟合的模型还必须适应物体几何形状和操作条件的变化。在本工作中，我们提出了AIM，一种自适应交互建模框架，将真实到仿真（real-to-sim）的软体仿真视为局部-全局交互建模问题。AIM利用运动历史和几何信息，在当前空间邻域和保留连接上自适应地调整粒子关系，同时通过几何条件化的全局通信来协调物体整体的响应。统一的运动学控制点接口表征不同的操作配置，多步自回归监督训练使模型基于自身预测轨迹进行学习。在PhysTwin和PGND上的实验表明，该框架在运动精度和视觉保真度上均有提升，相较于PhysTwin，未来预测跟踪误差降低了20.0%；相较于PGND，六类物体的平均长时域粒子误差降低了22.8%。该框架还支持跨动作、跨物体实例和跨场景的迁移，包括从机器人交互到人类操作的零样本迁移，而无需进行目标域动力学拟合。

Authors: Tiancheng Yang, Dingshuo Chen, Tianle Chen, Zhaocheng Liu, Qiang Liu

Physics Residual Dynamics and Reduced Order Whole-Body Planning for Obstacle Aware Human Robot Cloth CoTransportation Manipulation

cloth deformation prediction human-robot co-transportation reduced-order whole-body model model predictive path integral dual-arm mobile manipulator

简要说明：本文提出一种层次化规划框架，用于人机协作运输布料，结合物理残差循环变分自编码器预测布料变形，并使用降阶全身模型和MPPI/MPC规划器在双移动机械臂上实现避障运动。

TLDR: This paper presents a hierarchical planning framework for human-robot co-transportation of cloth, combining a physics-residual recurrent variational autoencoder for cloth deformation prediction with a reduced-order whole-body model and MPPI/MPC planners for obstacle-aware motion on a dual-arm mobile manipulator.

Abstract: Human--robot co-transportation of deformable objects requires predicting object deformation during motion, since obstacle clearance depends on both the grasp points and the unactuated interior. We present a hierarchical planning framework that combines a learned cloth model with a reduced-order whole-body model of a dual-arm mobile manipulator. A physics-residual conditional recurrent variational autoencoder (p-cRVAE) predicts the full cloth configuration from grasp-point observations by learning a residual correction to a computationally efficient linearized physics model, limiting error accumulation over 40-step planning horizon. The predicted cloth dynamics are embedded in a model predictive path integral (MPPI) planner using a reduced-order representation of a dual-arm mobile manipulator that preserves the non-holonomic base constraint and arm workspace limits. An MPC layer subsequently refines the sampled motion into smooth, executable references for whole-body control. The reduced-order formulation achieves tracking performance comparable to the full 17-DoF model while reducing computation time by approximately 80%. Across four co-transportation scenarios and two carrying speeds, the proposed framework maintains cloth-obstacle clearance where a corner-following baseline results in collisions, while whole-body refinement reduces final cloth deformation from 0.93\,m to 0.28\,m.

摘要（中文）：人机协作运输可变形物体要求在运动过程中预测物体变形，因为障碍物间隙既取决于抓取点，也取决于未驱动的内部区域。我们提出了一种分层规划框架，将学习到的布料模型与双臂移动操作器的降阶全身模型相结合。一种物理残差条件循环变分自编码器（p-cRVAE）通过学习对计算高效的线性化物理模型的残差修正，从抓取点观测中预测完整布料构型，从而限制40步规划时域内的误差累积。预测的布料动力学被嵌入到模型预测路径积分（MPPI）规划器中，该规划器采用双臂移动操作器的降阶表示，保留了非完整基座约束和机械臂工作空间限制。随后，MPC层将采样运动细化为平滑、可执行的全身控制参考轨迹。降阶公式实现了与完整17自由度模型相当的跟踪性能，同时将计算时间减少了约80%。在四种协同运输场景和两种搬运速度下，所提出的框架保持了布料与障碍物的间隙，而角点跟随基线方法则导致碰撞，同时全身细化将最终布料变形从0.93米减少到0.28米。

Authors: Moein Forouhar, Kosar Behnia, Anirvan Dutta, Hamid Sadeghian, Ville Kyrki, Sami Haddadin, Gokhan Alcan, Eckehard Steinbach

ArtifactArena: Evaluating Models by What They Build in the Physical World Other

hardware-software co-design physical simulation open-ended evaluation robot artifact design head-to-head tournaments

简要说明：ArtifactArena 是一个开放平台，前沿模型通过设计物理模拟器中的完整功能机器人进行竞赛，并使用 Elo 排名，支持社区持续参与。

TLDR: ArtifactArena is an open-ended platform where frontier models compete by designing fully functional robots in a physics simulator, with Elo rankings and sustainability for ongoing community challenges.

Abstract: To evaluate the frontier, we must measure models not by what they say, but by what they can engineer and build in grounded physical environments. We introduce \textsc{ArtifactArena}, an open-ended platform where models face a physically grounded hardware-software co-design challenge: engineering fully functional robots to compete in a simulated arena. We evaluate a frontier model's zero-shot, verifier guided refinement, and open-ended physical design capabilities through three harnesses that refine their bot artifacts based on text descriptions, physics simulator feedback, and gameplay data. We benchmark these capabilities with an Elo ranking of frontier models derived from head-to-head tournaments between their artifacts. By releasing this framework and tournament infrastructure for ongoing community submissions, we establish a living, non-saturating testbed to continuously measure the expanding limits of open-ended intelligence in the physical world. Please visit \href{https://artifactarena.ai}{https://artifactarena.ai} for more information.

摘要（中文）：为了评估前沿能力，我们不能仅依据模型说了什么，而应依据它们在真实物理环境中能够设计并实际构建出的成果来衡量。我们推出\textsc{ArtifactArena}，一个开放式平台，其中模型需面对一个基于实体的软硬件协同设计挑战：设计能参赛的全功能机器人，在模拟竞技场中竞争。我们通过三种评估机制来测试前沿模型的零样本能力、验证器引导的优化能力及开放式实体设计能力，这些机制分别基于文本描述、物理模拟器反馈及游戏数据进行机器人构件的优化。我们利用这些构件两两对抗的锦标赛结果，构建出前沿模型的Elo排名，以此作为基准。通过发布这一框架与竞赛基础设施，供社区持续提交作品，我们建立了一个持久且不会饱和的试验平台，以不断衡量开放式智能在物理世界中不断扩展的边界。更多信息请访问\href{https://artifactarena.ai}{https://artifactarena.ai}。

Authors: Kushagra Tiwary*, David Mayo*, Nikhil Behari, Xiangzhou Sun, Abdulrahman Alabdulkareem, Isaac Galatzer-Levy, Boris Katz, Brian Cheung

HexaGripper: A Single-Actuator, Winch-Deployed Gripper for Autonomous Aerial Parcel Collection Manipulation

aerial grasping winch-deployed single-actuator vision-based control parcel collection

简要说明：HexaGripper 提出了一种单执行器、绞盘部署的六板夹持器，用于自主空中包裹收集，集成了基于视觉的对准、测距传感和基于状态的控制，实验验证了高拾取成功率和室外可行性。

TLDR: HexaGripper presents a single-actuator, winch-deployed six-plate gripper for autonomous aerial parcel collection, integrating vision-based alignment, range sensing, and state-based control, with experimental validation showing high pickup success and outdoor viability.

Abstract: Autonomous aerial parcel collection remains constrained by package-transfer operations that require manual loading, landing, or dedicated ground infrastructure. This letter presents HexaGripper, a single-actuator, winch-deployed six-plate gripper for autonomous collection of cuboid parcels. The proposed mechanism provides synchronized grasping with a wide capture region and tolerance to positional misalignment during pickup. The system integrates vision-based alignment, range sensing, winch deployment, and state-based control to enable autonomous collection while maintaining UAV separation from the pickup surface. Experimental evaluation covered static grasping, capture-workspace assessment, and end-to-end outdoor aerial collection. Static experiments achieved 100% pickup success (15/15 trials) across three parcel geometries, while workspace experiments achieved successful pickup at all 28 tested positions up to a 150 mm radial offset. End-to-end outdoor aerial collection achieved an 80% success rate (4/5 trials). These results demonstrate the feasibility of mechanically synchronized, winch-deployed grasping for landing-free autonomous aerial parcel collection.

摘要（中文）：自主空中包裹采集仍受限于包裹传递操作，该操作要求人工装载、着陆或专用地面基础设施。本文提出HexaGripper——一种单驱动器、绞盘部署的六板抓取器，用于自主采集长方体包裹。该机构实现了同步抓取，具备宽捕获区域，并能容忍拾取过程中的位置偏差。系统集成基于视觉的对准、测距传感、绞盘部署及基于状态的控制，可实现自主采集，同时保持无人机与拾取表面分离。实验评估涵盖静态抓取、捕获工作空间评估及端到端户外空中采集。静态实验中，三种包裹几何构型均实现100%拾取成功率（15/15次试验），工作空间实验在全部28个测试位置（径向偏移达150毫米）均成功拾取。端到端户外空中采集实现80%成功率（4/5次试验）。上述结果验证了机械同步、绞盘部署式抓取用于无着陆自主空中包裹采集的可行性。

Towards Robust Prehensile Manipulation in Open-Ended Environments Manipulation

Quality-Diversity algorithms prehensile manipulation grasp configurations articulated objects open-ended environments

简要说明：本文提出使用质量-多样性算法，在开放环境中高效发现鲁棒的抓取配置，并生成多样化的操作轨迹，旨在提升在持续演化环境中的泛化与适应能力。

TLDR: The paper proposes using Quality-Diversity algorithms to discover robust grasp configurations and diverse prehensile manipulation trajectories for articulated objects in open-ended environments, aiming to improve generalization and adaptability in continuously evolving settings.

Abstract: We propose to use Quality-Diversity (QD) algorithms to solve robotic prehensile manipulation tasks in open-ended environments. Our approach enables the efficient discovery of a wide range robust grasp configurations, which serve as reliable starting points for generating diverse prehensile manipulation trajectories on articulated objects. The resulting diversity in manipulation behaviors enhances generalization and adaptability, enabling effective deployment continuously evolving open-world settings.

摘要（中文）：我们提出采用质量-多样性（QD）算法解决开放环境中的机器人抓取操作任务。该方法能够高效发现多种稳健的抓取构型，为在关节物体上生成多样化的抓取操作轨迹提供可靠起点。由此产生的操作行为多样性增强泛化能力与适应性，支持在持续演变的开放世界环境中有效部署。

Authors: Mathilde Kappel, Mahdi Khoramshahi, Louis Annabi, Faïz Ben Amar, Stéphane Doncieux

KineWorld: Action-Induced Transport Fields for Embodied World Modeling WorldModel

transport fields world models diffusion robot manipulation kinematics

简要说明：KineWorld 提出了一种传输感知的世界建模框架，利用运动学传输场对扩散训练目标进行重加权，从而改进具身操作中的动作后果预测。

TLDR: KineWorld introduces a transport-aware world modeling framework that uses kinematic transport fields to reweight diffusion training objectives, improving action-consequence prediction for embodied manipulation.

Abstract: Embodied world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions before execution. However, existing action-conditioned world models often adopt uniformly weighted visual generation objectives that can be misaligned with embodied prediction needs. Even with explicit motion conditioning, these objectives can underemphasize spatially sparse changes that are critical to interaction. We propose KineWorld, a transport-aware world-modeling framework that extends robot kinematics from motion conditioning to the spatial allocation of generative supervision. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs renderer-derived, camera-aligned transport fields from commanded robot motion. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates their motion support on the video-latent grid and reweights future-RGB flow matching through a normalized mixture of uniform and transport-focused distributions. We train KineWorld using ALOHA-AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0. KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results support a shift from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.

摘要（中文）：具身世界模型在动作执行之前预测候选动作的视觉结果。然而，现有的动作条件世界模型通常采用统一加权的视觉生成目标，这可能与具身预测需求不一致。即使有显式的运动条件，这些目标也可能低估对交互至关重要的空间稀疏变化。我们提出KineWorld，一种传输感知的世界建模框架，将机器人运动学从运动条件扩展到生成监督的空间分配。运动传输提升（KTL）从指令机器人运动构建渲染器派生的、相机对齐的传输场。传输感知世界扩散（TAWD）在视频潜在网格上校准其运动支持，并通过均匀分布与传输聚焦分布的归一化混合重新加权未来RGB流匹配。我们使用来自RoboTwin 2.0的ALOHA-AgileX双臂操作数据训练KineWorld。KineWorld在单视图评估中达到68.95的EWMScore-P，在多视图评估中达到54.82的TWB-Score。这些结果支持从外观拟合向动作后果建模的转变，以服务于具身决策。

Authors: Ziying Song, Yuchen Liu, Zhuoran Xu, Ziyang Liu, Jian Jin, Jiangtao Su, Haibao Yu, Lei Yang, Yuanpei Chen

Dual Variational Autoencoders for Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer in Low-Cost Robotic Navigation RLRobot

sim-to-real transfer dual variational autoencoders domain adaptation low-cost robot navigation domain randomization

简要说明：本文提出一种混合仿真到真实迁移框架，利用共享解码器的双卷积变分自编码器和域随机化对齐仿真与真实图像分布，在低成本机器人的室内导航任务中实现约91%的准确率。

TLDR: This paper presents a hybrid sim-to-real transfer framework using dual convolutional variational autoencoders with a shared decoder and domain randomization to align simulated and real-world image distributions, achieving ~91% accuracy on real-world indoor navigation for low-cost robots.

Abstract: Vision-based autonomous navigation for low-cost robots remains a fundamental challenge, primarily due to the significant gap between simulated training environments and real-world operational conditions. Direct policy transfer from simulation is often ineffective, while training exclusively on real data is impractical. We propose a hybrid transfer learning framework that effectively bridges the sim-to-real gap by combining domain randomization with feature-level domain adaptation. Our method employs a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture with a shared decoder, trained on an extensive set of 45225 simulated images and a minimal set of only 4556 real-world samples. This architecture learns a compact, common latent representation space that aligns the distributions of both domains. The adaptation process is further enhanced by two complementary data augmentation techniques designed to expand the limited real-world data. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves an average success rate of almost 91% on image classification tasks for real-world indoor navigation, significantly outperforming both simulation-only and real-world-only training. We validate these findings through a direct, real-world deployment, where the proposed policy successfully guides a low-cost robot in a reactive exploration task. Furthermore, we validate the model's efficiency through a rigorous computational estimation, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4 and NVIDIA Jetson Nano. This work presents a practical solution for developing effective and efficient navigation policies for low-cost robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的低成本机器人自主导航仍然是一个基础性挑战，这主要源于仿真训练环境与真实世界运行条件之间的显著差异。直接从仿真环境进行策略迁移往往效果不佳，而仅依赖真实数据进行训练又不切实际。我们提出了一种混合迁移学习框架，通过将域随机化与特征级域自适应相结合，有效弥合了仿真到现实之间的鸿沟。该方法采用带有共享解码器的双卷积变分自编码器架构，在45225张仿真图像的大规模数据集以及仅有4556张真实世界样本的小规模数据集上进行训练。该架构学习了一个紧凑且共同的潜在表示空间，使两个域的数据分布得以对齐。此外，两种互补的数据增强技术进一步增强了自适应过程，以扩展有限的真实世界数据。实验评估表明，我们的方法在真实世界室内导航的图像分类任务中实现了近91%的平均成功率，显著优于仅使用仿真数据和仅使用真实数据训练的方法。我们通过直接的真实世界部署验证了这些发现，所提出的策略成功引导了一台低成本机器人完成反应式探索任务。此外，我们通过严格的计算评估验证了模型的效率，确认其适用于资源受限的嵌入式平台，如Raspberry Pi 4和NVIDIA Jetson Nano。这项工作为低成本机器人系统开发高效、有效的导航策略提供了一种实用解决方案。

Authors: Álvaro Díez, Fidel Aznar

Inspect Robots: Evaluating the Capabilities and Safety of Embodied AI Other

embodied AI evaluation robotic safety language model policies open-source framework evaluation infrastructure

简要说明：本文介绍了Inspect Robots，一个用于评估由语言模型控制的具身AI代理能力与安全性的开源框架，并基于六个前沿模型策略进行了演示。

TLDR: This paper introduces Inspect Robots, an open-source framework for evaluating the capabilities and safety of embodied AI agents controlled by language models, demonstrated on six frontier model policies.

Abstract: General purpose language models are increasingly able to control robotic hardware. Understanding the capabilities and safety of these models when embodied is therefore increasingly important for understanding their societal impact and risks. To this end, we introduce Inspect Robots, a modular, open-source framework for developing and running evaluations of embodied agents. Inspect Robots pairs customizable, reusable abstractions for specifying physical evaluations and analyzing their results with infrastructure that automates evaluation setup, execution and termination. We demonstrate Inspect Robots by using it to evaluate the capabilities and safety of six policies based on frontier language models. Inspect Robots has seen significant early uptake, receiving nearly 100,000 downloads in the three months since its release.

摘要（中文）：通用型语言模型正日益具备控制机器人的能力。因此，理解这些模型在具身化条件下的能力与安全性，对于评估其社会影响与风险愈发重要。为此，我们推出了Inspect Robots框架，这是一个模块化、开源的工具，用于开发和运行具身智能体的评估。Inspect Robots将用于设定物理评估和分析结果的可定制、可复用抽象层，与自动化评估设置、执行和终止的基础设施相结合。我们通过评估六种基于前沿语言模型的策略，展示了Inspect Robots在能力与安全性方面的应用。自发布以来，Inspect Robots已获得广泛早期采用，三个月内下载量接近10万次。

Authors: Christopher Leet, Achu Menon, Sravanthi Machcha, Sabrina Zou, Aayushya Patel, Aditya Kumar Singh, Anish Kr Singh, Galaba Vamsi, Javin Ahuja, Sai Asish Yamani, Tushar Anand, Vedang Alle, Zihan Jack Zhang, Tzu Kit Chan, Jay Chooi

GAMBIT: Learning to Plan Continuous Multi-Robot Trajectories Other

multi-robot coordination motion primitives imitation learning reinforcement learning collision-free rollout

简要说明：GAMBIT 通过模仿学习和强化学习来学习多机器人运动原语的协调选择，并采用带备份轨迹的安全回滚机制，确保在连续域中超过一千个机器人的无碰撞执行。

TLDR: GAMBIT learns coordinated motion-primitive selection for multi-robot trajectory planning via imitation learning and reinforcement learning, with a safeguarded rollout mechanism that guarantees collision-free execution for over a thousand robots in continuous domains.

Abstract: GAMBIT is an opening chess move in which a player sacrifices a piece, typically a pawn, to gain a positional advantage later in the game. Analogously, in multi-robot coordination, individual robots may need to forgo locally reward-maximising behaviours to improve overall team performance. Such self-sacrificial behaviours are difficult to capture with manually designed heuristics, particularly in dense, interaction-rich environments. Focusing on double-integrator continuous dynamics, this work studies how to learn such coordinated heuristics over motion primitives for multi-robot trajectory execution. Our framework, GAMBIT, first learns coordinated motion-primitive selection through imitation learning and subsequently fine-tunes the policy through reinforcement learning. We further introduce a safeguarded rollout mechanism with backup trajectories that guarantees collision-free execution at all times. Experiments demonstrate that GAMBIT substantially outperforms a range of baselines, including centralised motion planners and decentralised reactive planners, while exhibiting strong scalability. In particular, it coordinates over a thousand robots with planning latency below a few hundred milliseconds in continuous domains.

摘要（中文）：GAMBIT是一种国际象棋的开局走法，指棋手牺牲一个棋子（通常是小兵）以在后续对局中获得位置优势。类似地，在多机器人协同中，个体机器人可能需要放弃局部收益最大化的行为，以提升整体团队表现。这种自我牺牲式的行为难以通过手工设计的启发式规则来捕捉，尤其是在密集且交互丰富的环境中。本文聚焦于双积分器连续动力学模型，研究如何学习基于运动原语的协同启发式规则，以实现多机器人轨迹执行。我们提出的框架GAMBIT首先通过模仿学习来学习协同的运动原语选择，随后通过强化学习对策略进行微调。我们进一步引入了一种带有备份轨迹的安全回滚机制，确保执行过程始终无碰撞。实验表明，GAMBIT在性能上大幅超越一系列基线方法，包括集中式运动规划器和分布式反应式规划器，同时展现出强大的可扩展性。具体而言，在连续域中，它能够协调超过一千个机器人，规划延迟低于几百毫秒。

Authors: Rishabh Jain, Akmaral Moldagalieva, Lorenzo Magnino, Michael Amir, Keisuke Okumura, Ajay Shankar, Wolfgang Hönig, Amanda Prorok

Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models Future Anchored Verification Online Recovery Robotic Manipulation Vision-Language Model

简要说明：FAVOR 提出了一种轻量级框架，利用世界动作模型预测的未来帧作为锚点来验证执行情况，并通过视觉语言模型生成纠正指令进行恢复，在不修改策略的情况下提升了 LIBERO 基准上的任务成功率。

TLDR: FAVOR introduces a lightweight framework for World Action Models that uses predicted future frames as anchors to verify execution and recover from deviations via vision-language-model-generated corrective instructions, improving task success on LIBERO benchmarks without policy modification.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. They act by first predicting how a task should be performed and then decoding the actions from that future. However, the remaining actions are invalid once execution drifts from the prediction. Simply replanning from the already out of distribution state rarely restores what the task still requires; existing execution monitors decide when to stop, but not what to restore. We observe that the answer is already in hand: the future the WAM predicted before acting depicts exactly the states it intended to pass through. We introduce FAVOR (Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery), a lightweight framework that keeps these predicted frames as anchors and uses them for verification and recovery. An Anchor Verifier compares each observation with its anchor, together with the executed actions, to flag deviations that break the task. Anchor-Guided Recovery uses a vision-language model to turn the flagged anchor into a short corrective instruction. Under strengthened instruction guidance, the WAM executes this instruction to return to the intended future. It then resumes the task. FAVOR raises the task success of the base WAM from 97.85% to 98.10% on LIBERO and from 72.60% to 72.98% on LIBERO-Plus without modifying the policy.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）已成为机器人操作领域一种前景广阔的范式。其运作方式为：首先预测任务应如何执行，随后从该未来状态中解码出相应动作。然而，一旦实际执行偏离预测，剩余动作即告失效。仅从已偏离分布的状态重新规划，难以恢复任务仍所需的要素；现有执行监控机制仅决定何时停止，而非应恢复何种状态。我们观察到，答案其实已在掌握之中：WAM在行动前预测的未来，恰恰描绘了其预期经过的状态序列。为此，我们提出FAVOR（未来锚定验证与在线恢复）框架——一种轻量级方案，将预测帧保留为锚点，并利用其进行验证与恢复。锚点验证器将每次观测与对应锚点及已执行动作进行比较，以标记破坏任务的偏离情况。锚点引导恢复则借助视觉语言模型，将标记的锚点转化为简短修正指令。在强化指令引导下，WAM执行该指令以回归预期未来，随后继续原任务。在LIBERO基准上，FAVOR将基础WAM的任务成功率从97.85%提升至98.10%；在LIBERO-Plus上，从72.60%提升至72.98%，且无需修改策略。

Authors: Zhibin Qin, Zhenxiong Tan, Xinchao Wang

Towards Quadruped-Provided Localization and Active Tracking for Micro-UAVs Locomotion

quadruped robot micro-UAV active tracking fiducial markers external localization

简要说明：本文提出一种系统，由带7自由度机械臂的四足机器人通过AprilTag标记为微型无人机提供外部6自由度位姿，实现轻量无人机的自主飞行和地面机器人的主动跟踪。

TLDR: This paper presents a system where a quadruped robot with a 7-DOF arm provides external 6-DOF pose localization to a micro-UAV via AprilTag fiducial markers, enabling autonomous flight of a lightweight drone and active tracking by the ground robot.

Abstract: Micro unmanned aerial vehicles (micro-UAVs) are small enough to reach confined spaces that larger robots cannot access, but too small to carry the sensing and computing power required for autonomous flight. We move the localization stack entirely off the aerial platform onto a quadruped robot with a 7-degree-of-freedom (DOF) arm, which supplies the micro-UAV (27 g bare, 42 g with fiducial markers) its full 6-DOF pose. A camera at the arm's end-effector detects AprilTag fiducial markers on the drone and composes that observation with the quadruped's own self-localization to place the drone in a shared map frame, so the ground robot localizes its partner, rather than only tracking it relative to the camera. The arm acts as an actively-controlled observer, repositioning to keep the drone in view as both robots move; the drone carries only an inertial measurement unit and fuses the external pose to fly commanded setpoints. In lab flights the external pose is accurate to 12-16 mm, enough to fly the drone autonomously within 2-5 cm of motion-capture-fed control. Having the quadruped actively follow the drone reduces the tracking error from 11.0 cm to 6.9 cm by holding the camera in the close range, where the markers are most accurate.

摘要（中文）：微型无人机（micro-UAV）体积小巧，能够进入大型机器人无法到达的狭窄空间，但其尺寸也限制了其携带自主飞行所需传感与计算能力。我们将定位系统完全从空中平台转移至配备七自由度（DOF）机械臂的四足机器人上，由后者为微型无人机（裸机27克，携带标识物时42克）提供完整的六自由度（6-DOF）位姿。机械臂末端执行器上的相机检测无人机上的AprilTag标识物，并将该观测数据与四足机器人自身的自定位信息融合，从而在共享地图坐标系中确定无人机的位置，使地面机器人能够对其伙伴进行定位，而不仅仅是相对于相机进行跟踪。机械臂充当主动控制的观测器，在双机器人运动过程中不断调整位置以确保无人机始终处于视野内；无人机仅携带惯性测量单元，融合外部位姿信息以执行设定的飞行指令。在实验室飞行测试中，外部位姿精度达到12-16毫米，足以使无人机在运动捕捉系统供控的2-5厘米误差范围内实现自主飞行。四足机器人主动跟随无人机时，通过将相机保持在标识物精度最高的近距离范围内，跟踪误差从11.0厘米降至6.9厘米。

Authors: Alejandro Lorite Mora, Andrés Faíña

Talk, Render, Act: Integrating Social Gesture and Digital Face with Synchronized Speech for Conversational Humanoid Robot HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid robot social gesture generation facial animation speech synchronization semantic motion atoms

简要说明：该论文提出了TRABot，一个基于智能体的框架，将语音、面部动画和身体姿态整合到会话式人形机器人中，通过语义动作单元和组合规划器在实体G1机器人上实现连贯的多模态交互。

TLDR: The paper presents TRABot, an agent-based framework that integrates speech, facial animation, and body gestures for a conversational humanoid robot, using semantic motion atoms and a compositional planner for coherent multimodal interaction on a physical G1 robot.

Abstract: Expressive humanoid interaction requires speech, facial animation, and body gestures to form a coherent response. However, many full-body humanoid robots produce speech and gestures without a visually expressive face, while talking-face animation and robot gesture generation are typically developed separately. We present Talk, Render, Act (TRABot), an agent-based framework comprising specialized agents for motion-atom construction, dialogue generation, motion planning, and facial animation. First, to produce natural and semantically meaningful gestures, we construct Robot-Ready Semantic Motion Atoms by segmenting long-form, G1-retargeted BEAT2 motion into units with natural gesture boundaries, human-verified communicative functions, and feasible trajectories. Second, to preserve semantic order and coordinate body motion with the spoken response, we introduce a Semantic-Conditioned Compositional Planner. Given an ordered semantic function sequence and an estimated response duration, the planner selects approved atoms to realize the longest feasible action sequence while accounting for transitions and neutral recovery. Finally, we deploy a Streaming Face-Speech-Body Integration system on a physical G1 humanoid, combining streaming dialogue audio, audio-driven facial animation, and semantically planned body motion in a unified real-time interaction loop. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that TRAbot achieves the best overall performance among all compared conditions in terms of naturalness, expressiveness, and multimodal coherence.

摘要（中文）：表达性人形交互需要语音、面部动画和身体姿态共同构成连贯的回应。然而，许多全身人形机器人在产生语音和姿态的同时缺乏具有视觉表现力的面部，而说话面部动画与机器人姿态生成通常是分别开发的。我们提出了Talk, Render, Act（TRABot），一种基于智能体的框架，包含用于运动原子构建、对话生成、运动规划和面部动画的专用智能体。首先，为生成自然且语义上有意义的姿态，我们通过将长序列、经G1重定向的BEAT2运动分割为具有自然姿态边界、经人工验证的交际功能以及可行轨迹的单元，构建了机器人就绪的语义运动原子。其次，为保持语义顺序并使身体运动与语音回应相协调，我们引入了语义条件组合规划器。给定有序的语义功能序列和估计的回应时长，规划器选择已批准的运动原子来实现最长的可行动作序列，同时考虑过渡和中性恢复。最后，我们在实体G1人形机器人上部署了流式面部-语音-身体集成系统，将流式对话音频、音频驱动的面部动画和语义规划的身体运动统一到实时交互循环中。定量和定性实验表明，TRABot在自然性、表现力和多模态连贯性方面，在所有对比条件下取得了最佳总体性能。

Robotizing Human Videos with Physically Consistent Interactions Manipulation

简要说明：本文通过交互感知的接触重建和深度感知的合成，提高了将人类演示视频转换为机器人兼容训练数据的物理一致性，并在仿真和真实任务中展示了与机器人数据联合训练的增益。

TLDR: This paper improves the physical consistency of converting human demonstration videos into robot-compatible training data by adding interaction-aware contact reconstruction and depth-aware compositing, showing gains in co-training robot policies on simulated and real tasks.

Abstract: Human videos offer scalable manipulation data, but the embodiment gap between human hands and robot manipulators limits their direct use. Existing video-editing methods replace hands with rendered robots, yet inaccurate interaction reconstruction and compositing can produce inconsistent grasps and implausible robot-object occlusions. We address these failures from two complementary physical aspects: interaction geometry and scene visibility. First, an interaction-aware contact reconstruction module combines hand-object segmentation with mesh-level contact prediction to recover dense 3D contacts, then converts them into temporally stabilized grasps for parallel-jaw grippers. Second, a depth-aware compositing module uses scene and robot depth to enforce physically consistent robot-object occlusions. The resulting videos preserve the interaction structure of human demonstrations in a robot-compatible form and are co-trained with robot demonstrations. Using identical human videos and robot data, we compare against robot-only training and the original Masquerade pipeline. Across four RoboTwin tasks and two Diffusion Policy visual encoders, our method achieves the highest average success rates, with especially strong gains under out-of-distribution scene variation. Real-world deployment further shows that the proposed co-training approach improves robustness to visual distractors when the task geometry is observable, while performance on depth-sensitive grasps remains limited by the single-camera setup.

摘要（中文）：人类视频提供了可扩展的操作数据，但人类手部与机器人操作器之间的具身差异限制了其直接使用。现有视频编辑方法通过渲染机器人替换手部，然而不准确的交互重建和合成可能导致抓取不一致以及机器人-物体遮挡不合理。我们从两个互补的物理层面解决这些失败：交互几何和场景可见性。首先，一个交互感知的接触重建模块结合手-物分割与网格级接触预测，恢复密集的三维接触，并将其转换为适用于平行夹爪的时间稳定抓取。其次，一个深度感知的合成模块利用场景和机器人深度信息，强制实现物理一致的机器人-物体遮挡。生成的视频以机器人兼容的形式保留了人类示范的交互结构，并与机器人示范进行联合训练。在相同的人类视频和机器人数据条件下，我们与仅使用机器人训练以及原始Masquerade流程进行了比较。在四个RoboTwin任务和两种Diffusion Policy视觉编码器上，我们的方法取得了最高的平均成功率，尤其在分布外场景变化下表现尤为突出。真实世界部署进一步表明，当任务几何可观测时，所提出的联合训练方法能提升对视觉干扰物的鲁棒性，而在深度敏感抓取任务上的性能仍受限于单相机设置。

Authors: Ching-Lam Cheng, Shengfeng He, Bin Zhu

MagServo: Uncertainty-Resilient Hierarchical Magnetic Servoing via Learned Latent Representations Manipulation

magnetic servoing latent representation model predictive control 6-DoF learning-based control

简要说明：MagServo 提出了一种基于分层学习的 6 自由度磁伺服框架，利用学习到的潜在磁特征，对噪声和干扰具有鲁棒性，在真实机器人上实现了亚毫米和亚度级精度。

TLDR: MagServo presents a hierarchical learning-based framework for 6-DoF magnetic servoing that uses learned latent magnetic representations, robust to noise and disturbances, achieving sub-millimeter and sub-degree accuracy on real robots.

Abstract: Magnetic navigation provides contact-free and line-of-sight-independent feedback for robotic systems, yet existing approaches typically rely on explicit pose estimation or direct use of raw magnetic measurements, making accurate control susceptible to modeling errors, measurement noise, and disturbances. This work presents MagServo, a hierarchical learning-based framework for robust 6-DoF magnetic servoing directly using the learned latent magnetic feature. MagServo learns uncertainty-resilient magnetic representations through masked reconstruction and captures state-dependent interaction dynamics between robot motion and latent magnetic transitions without analytical magnetic models or explicit Jacobian supervision. Based on the learned dynamics, a hierarchical controller combines nonlinear model predictive control for coarse approach with local Jacobian inversion for precise fine regulation. Extensive physical experiments demonstrate submillimeter and subdegree accuracy, achieving mean terminal errors of 0.386 mm and 0.479 degree for 6-DoF pose reaching. MagServo further outperforms a localization-based control baseline in complex trajectory tracking and maintains robust performance under unseen magnetic-source configurations without retraining. A supplementary video of the real-robot experiments is available at https://youtu.be/rZt1NUP1Mr0.

摘要（中文）：磁导航为机器人系统提供无接触且不受视线限制的反馈，然而现有方法通常依赖显式的位姿估计或直接使用原始磁测量数据，这使得精确控制容易受到建模误差、测量噪声和扰动的影响。本工作提出MagServo，一种基于分层学习的框架，直接利用学习得到的潜在磁特征实现鲁棒的六自由度磁伺服控制。MagServo通过掩码重建学习具有不确定性鲁棒性的磁表示，并在无需解析磁模型或显式雅可比监督的情况下，捕获机器人运动与潜在磁变迁之间依赖于状态的交互动力学。基于学习到的动力学模型，分层控制器将用于粗逼近的非线性模型预测控制与用于精细调节的局部雅可比求逆相结合。大量物理实验表明，该方法达到亚毫米和亚度级精度，六自由度位姿到达任务的平均末端误差为0.386毫米和0.479度。MagServo在复杂轨迹跟踪中进一步优于基于定位的控制基线，并在未见过的磁源配置下无需重新训练即可保持鲁棒性能。真实机器人实验的补充视频可在https://youtu.be/rZt1NUP1Mr0获取。

Authors: Yuhan Tan, Yameng Zhang, Pei Liu, Yao Zhong, Zhongliang Jiang

Recon2Servo: Robotic Ultrasound Visual Servoing via Learned Image-to-Motion Inference Manipulation

visual servoing robotic ultrasound image-to-motion inference relative pose estimation closed-loop control

简要说明：Recon2Servo 提出了一种用于机器人超声的视觉伺服框架，直接从 2D B 超图像推断 6 自由度探头位姿变化，使用带低秩适应的 DINOv3 编码器和双向关系模块，并在公共数据集、内部数据集及真实机器人演示中验证。

TLDR: Recon2Servo presents a learned visual servoing framework for robotic ultrasound that infers 6-DoF probe pose changes directly from 2D B-mode images, using a DINOv3 encoder with low-rank adaptation and a bidirectional relation module, validated on public and in-house datasets and real-robot demonstrations.

Abstract: Ultrasound visual servoing is essential for autonomous robotic ultrasound, yet 6-DoF probe control from 2D B-mode images remains challenging due to limited and ambiguous out-of-plane motion cues. Existing methods typically rely on anatomical priors or handcrafted visual features, limiting their generalizability across imaging targets. Inspired by trackerless 3D ultrasound reconstruction, we propose Recon2Servo, a visual servoing framework that learns image-to-motion inference directly from B-mode images for 6-DoF probe control. A DINOv3 encoder with low-rank adaptation and a bidirectional relation module estimate the relative probe pose between current and target images to guide iterative closed-loop target-view alignment. The framework combines supervised relative-pose learning, reconstruction-guided closed-loop adaptation, and bounded residual pose correction to improve motion inference during servoing. Evaluations on a public dataset and an in-house dataset collected from 12 healthy volunteers using different ultrasound systems demonstrate its effectiveness in reconstructed-volume servoing. Additional real-robot demonstrations of target-view alignment and dynamic tracking on a human forearm are provided in the supplementary video: https://youtu.be/qwsOdI-GMYk.

摘要（中文）：超声视觉伺服对于自主机器人超声检查至关重要，然而从二维B模式图像实现六自由度探头控制仍具挑战性，主要源于平面外运动线索有限且存在歧义。现有方法通常依赖解剖先验或手工设计的视觉特征，限制了其在不同成像目标间的泛化能力。受无追踪器三维超声重建的启发，我们提出Recon2Servo，一种直接从B模式图像学习图像到运动映射的视觉伺服框架，用于六自由度探头控制。该框架采用带低秩适配的DINOv3编码器及双向关系模块，估计当前图像与目标图像之间的相对探头位姿，以引导迭代闭环目标视图对齐。该框架结合了监督式相对位姿学习、重建引导的闭环自适应以及有界残差位姿校正，以提升伺服过程中的运动推断性能。在公开数据集及使用不同超声系统从12名健康志愿者采集的内部数据集上的评估，验证了其在重建体伺服中的有效性。补充视频中提供了人体前臂目标视图对齐及动态跟踪的额外真实机器人演示：https://youtu.be/qwsOdI-GMYk。

Authors: Yameng Zhang, Pei Liu, Dianye Huang, Yizhao Qian, Zhongyu Chen, Xiangyu Chu, K. W. Samuel Au, Zhongliang Jiang

P3: Persistent Particle Planning for Constrained Diffusion Control RLRobot

sequential Monte Carlo diffusion control constraint-aware weighting replanning maze navigation

简要说明：P3是一种顺序蒙特卡洛框架，在扩散控制中跨重规划步骤维护候选计划的加权种群，以确保约束可行性并降低重规划成本。

TLDR: P3 is a sequential Monte Carlo framework that maintains a weighted population of candidate plans across replanning steps for diffusion-based control, ensuring constraint feasibility and reducing replanning costs.

Abstract: Diffusion models provide expressive priors over trajectories, but adapting these priors to test-time constraints requires maintaining feasibility and consistency across successive control decisions. We introduce Persistent Particle Planning (P3), a sequential Monte Carlo framework for diffusion control that maintains a weighted population of candidate plans across replanning steps. At each control step, P3 shifts and partially re-noises the candidate trajectories, refines them under the latest observation, and uses constraint-aware weighting and resampling to select among alternative continuations without retraining the diffusion model. We consider denoising and replanning as one Feynman--Kac particle system and analyze it under an idealized repair. We prove that the re-noising depth controls how reliably a kept plan stays on its route, and that keeping a rare, well-separated route takes far fewer plans than rediscovering it by sampling from scratch. Experiments under multiple test-time constraint configurations show that population reuse reduces route switching and improves success without constraint violations. Because P3 refines earlier plans instead of redrawing them, it also needs fewer denoising iterations per replan. On maze-navigation tasks, it plans faster than both regenerated populations and methods that correct a single sampled plan by constrained optimization. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/p3-username/p3-anon.

摘要（中文）：扩散模型为轨迹提供了丰富的先验分布，但在测试时约束下适应这些先验需要保持连续控制决策之间的可行性和一致性。我们提出了持久化粒子规划（P3），一种用于扩散控制的序贯蒙特卡洛框架，它在重新规划步骤之间维护一组带权重的候选计划群体。在每个控制步骤中，P3对候选轨迹进行平移和部分重新加噪，根据最新观测对它们进行细化，并使用考虑约束的权重分配和重采样来在替代延续方案之间进行选择，而无需重新训练扩散模型。我们将去噪和重新规划视为一个Feynman–Kac粒子系统，并在理想化修复假设下对其进行分析。我们证明了重新加噪深度控制着保留计划在其路径上保持可靠性的程度，并且保留一条稀有且分离良好的路径所需的计划数量远少于从头采样重新发现该路径所需的计划数量。在多种测试时约束配置下的实验表明，群体复用减少了路径切换，并在不违反约束的情况下提高了成功率。由于P3细化先前的计划而非重新绘制它们，因此每次重新规划所需的去噪迭代次数也更少。在迷宫导航任务中，它的规划速度快于重新生成的群体以及通过约束优化修正单个采样计划的方法。代码和预训练模型可在 https://github.com/p3-username/p3-anon 获取。

Authors: Hikmet Simsir, Mahyar Fardinfar, Ozgur S. Oguz

EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models WorldModel

stochastic JEPA latent world model flow-matching uncertainty-driven exploration CEM planning

简要说明：本文提出 EpicWorldModel，一种基于随机 JEPA 的潜在世界模型，通过流匹配预测部分可观测条件下的多种未来状态，并利用预测方差指导 CEM 规划中的探索，提升了潜在规划任务的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces EpicWorldModel, a stochastic JEPA-based latent world model that uses flow-matching to predict multiple possible future states under partial observability, and leverages predictive variance as exploration guidance for CEM planning, improving success rates in latent planning tasks.

Abstract: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.

摘要（中文）：基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的潜在世界模型在设计上是确定性的。尽管在完全可观测场景中表现良好，但当过去的观测和行动导致多个合理未来可能性时（例如由遮挡引起），该范式便失效了。我们提出了EpicWorldModel，一个用于在部分可观测条件下训练具有内在不确定性的环境和任务的随机JEPA框架。我们联合训练EpicWorldModel的预测器及其潜在表示空间，通过流匹配目标直接预测多个潜在未来状态，特别是在 conditioning 历史中缺乏目标相关场景内容时。我们证明，流预测方差（受其与预测熵上界关系的启发）可作为规划中有用的探索指导。通过将此不确定性信号纳入基于交叉熵方法（CEM）的规划中，我们的方法在目标达成与探索可能隐藏遮挡目标的不确定区域之间取得了平衡。我们通过一系列潜在规划实验证明了EpicWorldModel的有效性，其在各任务中表现最佳或持平，与LeWorldModel相比，成功率实现了最高22%的经验性提升。

Authors: Bowen Feng, Julian Ost, May Mei, Anirudha Majumdar, Felix Heide

Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization RLRobot

diffusion policy reinforcement learning reachability analysis safety constraint continuous control

简要说明：本文提出了一种可达性感知扩散策略优化方法（RADPO），这是一种无模型的安全感知扩散策略优化方法，通过结合预测性首次命中可达性估计与累积成本预算反馈来塑造奖励，并在连续控制安全任务中改善奖励-成本权衡。

TLDR: This paper proposes Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free safety-aware diffusion policy optimization method that combines predictive first-hit reachability estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback to shape rewards and improve reward-cost trade-offs in continuous-control safety tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.

摘要（中文）：扩散策略为连续控制强化学习提供了具有表现力的动作分布。然而，面向安全性的在线扩散策略优化仍未被充分探索，尤其是那些无需显式动力学模型即可利用预测性可达信息的方法。我们提出了可达性感知扩散策略优化方法（RADPO），这是一种无模型方法，结合了预测性首次命中安全估计与累积成本预算反馈。RADPO学习一个折扣首次命中可达性值，该值捕捉成本事件的折扣风险，对发生更早的事件赋予更大权重，并利用该信号来塑造奖励。一个独立的类似对偶的乘子根据实际回合成本相对于预设预算的偏差来调整塑造强度。扩散演员通过对由奖励评论家评分的候选动作进行加权去噪回归来改进。我们的方法既不需要学习动力学模型、通过评论家的动作梯度，也不需要经过逆向扩散采样器的微分。我们建立了可达性值的理论性质，并证明累积可达性惩罚为未来折扣累积成本提供了一个保守的替代指标。在十个连续控制安全任务中，RADPO实现了具有竞争力的奖励-成本权衡，在多个任务上相较于对比基线显著减少了约束违反。我们的理论和实证分析支持，将可达性与累积预算反馈相结合是构建安全感知扩散策略的一种可行方法。

Authors: Hikmet Simsir, Kutay Demiray, Ozgur S. Oguz

From Social Reasoning to Embodied Interaction: An Agentic Framework for Social Robots HumanoidEmbodied

social reasoning embodied interaction humanoid robot streaming execution multimodal context understanding

简要说明：ARISE 是一个针对 Sophia 人形机器人的统一智能体框架，它将多模态推理、长期记忆和主动/被动交互与机器人原生手势、语音和面部表情相结合，展示了更高的感知交互质量和更低的延迟。

TLDR: ARISE is a unified agentic framework for the Sophia humanoid robot that bridges multimodal reasoning, long-term memory, and proactive/reactive interaction with robot-native gestures, speech, and facial expressions, demonstrating improved perceived interaction quality and reduced latency.

Abstract: Natural face-to-face human--robot interaction requires a robot to understand an evolving social situation, decide when to engage, and express its intent through coordinated physical behavior. Yet existing approaches rarely close this loop: foundation-model agents provide increasingly capable multimodal reasoning and memory but remain largely disembodied, while expressive virtual agents do not face the physical constraints of real robots, and physical social robots typically address social reasoning and embodied expression only partially. We present ARISE, a unified framework that bridges Agentic Reasoning and Interactive Social Embodiment on the Sophia humanoid robot. ARISE integrates multimodal context understanding, long-term memory, and reactive and proactive interaction to determine when and what to communicate, and translates social intent into robot-native gestures coordinated with speech and mechanical facial expressions through streaming execution. Extensive evaluations on Sophia demonstrate strong perceived interaction quality, expressive and well-coordinated embodied behavior, and substantial latency reductions through streaming execution. These results highlight the importance of jointly reasoning about what to communicate, when to engage, and how to physically express social intent for natural interaction with humanoid robots. Project Page: https://robosocial.github.io/

摘要（中文）：自然的人与人形机器人交互要求机器人理解不断变化的社会情境，决定何时参与互动，并通过协调的身体行为表达其意图。然而，现有方法很少能形成闭环：基础模型智能体提供了日益强大的多模态推理与记忆能力，但在很大程度上仍缺乏具身性；表达型虚拟智能体则无需面对真实机器人的物理约束；而实体社交机器人通常仅部分实现社会推理与具身表达。我们提出了ARISE，一个在Sophia人形机器人上统一智能体推理与交互式社会具身的框架。ARISE整合了多模态情境理解、长期记忆以及反应性和主动性交互，以决定何时沟通及沟通什么内容，并通过流式执行将社交意图转化为与语音及机械面部表情相协调的机器人原生手势。在Sophia上开展的广泛评估表明，该方法在感知交互质量、表达性与协调性具身行为方面表现出色，并通过流式执行显著降低了延迟。这些结果凸显了在与人形机器人进行自然交互时，对沟通内容、参与时机以及身体表达社交意图方式进行联合推理的重要性。项目页面：https://robosocial.github.io/

Authors: Ziyu Cheng, Yuewen Guo, Zhirui Liu, Dong Zhang, Haotao Lu, Jingyi Yu, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang

Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Collision-Free Locomotion of an Underactuated Biped Locomotion

Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Bipedal locomotion Obstacle avoidance Underactuated robot Soft Actor-Critic

简要说明：本文提出一种用于欠驱动双足运动的分层强化学习框架，高层策略生成体速度命令以避免障碍，低层策略跟踪这些命令，在静态和动态环境中的成功率均优于经典规划器基线。

TLDR: This paper presents a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for underactuated bipedal locomotion, where a high-level policy generates body-velocity commands for obstacle avoidance and a low-level policy tracks these commands, achieving superior success rates in static and dynamic environments compared to classical planner baselines.

Abstract: A bipedal robot cannot deviate from its path to avoid an obstacle without disturbing its balance, and this coupling is most severe on underactuated platforms such as the biped considered here, which has four actuated joints per leg and no hip or ankle roll. This paper presents a Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) framework in which a High-Level (HL) policy observes the robot pose, 36 raycast proximity measurements, moving-obstacle states, and a receding-horizon local goal, and outputs a body-velocity command $(v_x, v_y, ω_{yaw})$ every ten control steps, while a velocity-conditioned Low-Level (LL) policy tracks each command through PD-controlled joint targets. Both policies are trained jointly with Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). Because the converged gait is task-agnostic, it is frozen and driven by classical planners over the same command interface, yielding three controlled baselines: SAC+A*, SAC+RRT*, and SAC+APF. Across 100 evaluation trials per method in randomized PyBullet environments, the proposed method reaches the goal in 98.0% of static and 88.0% of dynamic trials, against at most 78.0% and 68.0% for the planner hybrids, with path lengths within 4% of the A* reference, and ablations confirm that each observation channel and reward term contributes materially to this performance.

摘要（中文）：双足机器人在避开障碍物时无法偏离既定路径而不影响其平衡，而这种耦合效应在欠驱动平台上尤为严重，例如本文所研究的双足机器人——其每条腿具有四个驱动关节，且没有髋关节或踝关节的滚转自由度。本文提出了一种分层强化学习（HRL）框架，其中高层（HL）策略观测机器人姿态、36条射线投射邻近测量、移动障碍物状态以及滚动时域的局部目标，并每隔十个控制周期输出一个机体速度指令 $(v_x, v_y, ω_{yaw})$，而速度条件化的低层（LL）策略则通过PD控制的关节目标跟踪每个指令。两个策略均使用软演员-评论家（SAC）算法进行联合训练。由于收敛后的步态与任务无关，因此将其冻结，并通过经典规划器在同一指令接口上驱动，从而产生三个受控基线：SAC+A*、SAC+RRT* 和 SAC+APF。在随机化的PyBullet环境中，每种方法进行100次评估试验，所提出的方法在静态试验中达到目标的成功率为98.0%，在动态试验中为88.0%，而规划器混合方法最高分别为78.0%和68.0%，且路径长度与A*参考值偏差在4%以内。消融实验证实，每个观测通道和奖励项对上述性能均有实质性贡献。

Authors: Jagannath Prasad Sahoo, Saurabh Kumar, Surya Prakash S. K., Samiran Datta, Abhay Dwivedi, Amit Shukla

Dual-Rate Force-Image Control with Model-Based Orientation Limits for Robotic Ultrasound Manipulation

robotic ultrasound dual-rate control force control image-guided orientation-rate limit

简要说明：本论文提出了一种用于机器人超声的双速率控制框架，通过解析的朝向速率限制来防止图像引导的探头旋转干扰接触力，并在体模和腘窝扫描中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a dual-rate control framework for robotic ultrasound that uses a closed-form orientation-rate limit to prevent image-guided probe rotation from perturbing contact force, validated on phantoms and a popliteal scan.

Abstract: Robotic ultrasound couples a high-rate contact-force loop with slower, delayed image feedback, so image-guided ultrasound probe rotation can perturb contact force before the resulting image response is observed. We derive a closed-form orientation-rate limit that bounds the modeled rotation-induced estimated-force excursion over a finite horizon while accounting for disturbance rejection by the fast force loop. The limit depends on local contact stiffness, force-loop gains, a conservative rotation-to-force gain bound, the excursion budget, and the prediction horizon. We implement this model in a dual-rate controller with timestamp-based delay reconstruction and joint-torque-based force estimation, and evaluate it on a curved gelatin phantom using paired controller comparisons and component ablations. Relative to unconstrained image guidance, the proposed rate-limited controller reduced first-second root-mean-square (RMS) estimated-force error by 0.40 N while increasing cue-convergence time by 0.94 s. A fixed rate cap near the analytically predicted ceiling produced no resolvable difference in force error and converged 0.32 s faster, indicating that the principal practical value of the model is the rate-design rule rather than online prediction. Delay reconstruction had no resolvable effect at the tested latency. A single-subject popliteal scan demonstrated feasibility, although the image cue was noise-limited on heterogeneous tissue.

摘要（中文）：机器人超声将高速接触力回路与较慢且存在延迟的图像反馈相结合，因此图像引导下的超声探头旋转可能在观测到相应图像响应之前就扰动接触力。我们推导出一个闭式转角速率极限，该极限在有限时域内约束由建模的旋转引起的估计力偏离范围，同时考虑快速力回路的扰动抑制能力。该极限取决于局部接触刚度、力回路增益、保守的旋转-力增益界、偏离预算以及预测时域。我们在一个双速率控制器中实现该模型，采用基于时间戳的延迟重构和基于关节力矩的力估计，并在弯曲明胶体模上通过配对控制器比较和组件消融实验进行评估。与无约束图像引导相比，所提出的速率限制控制器将第一秒均方根（RMS）估计力误差降低了0.40 N，同时使提示收敛时间增加了0.94 s。在接近解析预测上限处设置固定速率上限时，力误差无可分辨差异，且收敛时间加快了0.32 s，这表明该模型的主要实用价值在于速率设计准则而非在线预测。在所测试的延迟水平下，延迟重构无可分辨影响。单受试者腘窝扫描验证了可行性，尽管在异质组织上图像提示受噪声限制。

Authors: Tyler Foster, Qiang Zhang, A B M Tahidul Haque, Anh Thu Nguyen

DASH: A da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid Robots as an Accessible Platform for Surgical Robotics Research Manipulation

surgical robotics teleoperation hardware adapter da Vinci instruments general-purpose robots

简要说明：本文提出了DASH，一种硬件适配器，可将达芬奇手术器械安装在通用串联机器人和人形机器人上，无需修改器械即可实现遥操作手术机器人研究。实验证明了适配器的有效性，旨在降低手术机器人研究的成本门槛。

TLDR: This paper presents DASH, a hardware adapter that allows da Vinci surgical instruments to be mounted on general-purpose serial-link and humanoid robots, enabling teleoperated surgical robotics research without modifying the instruments. The work demonstrates the adapters' efficacy in teleoperated experiments and aims to lower the cost barrier for surgical robotics research.

Abstract: Robotic minimally invasive surgery offers well-documented clinical benefits, but the cost and infrastructure requirements of purpose-built platforms limit access in rural and lower-resourced facilities. Recent work has teleoperated general-purpose robots for laparoscopic tasks and in vivo procedures, but relied on handheld instruments coupled through passive linkages rather than native robotic actuation. Instead, we adapt da Vinci Classic and Xi instruments onto general-purpose robots that can integrate in clinical workflows. We present DASH, a da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid platforms, consisting of two types of adapters that require no modification to the instruments themselves. Each adapter is compatible with many robotic platform load capacities, engages the instrument's native latch, and wirelessly identifies inserted tools to load instrument-specific kinematics and coupling matrices. Teleoperated experiments demonstrate the efficacy of DASH and its benefits for enabling research access to surgical robotic platforms.

摘要（中文）：机器人微创手术具有公认的临床优势，但专用平台的成本和基础设施要求限制了其在乡村及资源匮乏医疗机构中的应用。近期研究已利用通用机器人对腹腔镜任务及体内手术进行遥操作，但这些研究依赖于通过被动连杆连接的手持器械，而非机器人原生驱动。为此，我们将达芬奇经典及Xi型器械适配至能够融入临床工作流程的通用机器人上。我们提出DASH（达芬奇串联与类人平台适配器），包含两种无需对器械本身进行改装的适配器类型。每种适配器均兼容多种机器人平台承载能力，接合器械原生锁扣，并通过无线方式识别插入的工具，以加载器械特定的运动学及耦合矩阵。遥操作实验验证了DASH的有效性及其在促进手术机器人平台研究可及性方面的优势。

Authors: Sara Wickenhiser, Junrong Zhou, Zekai Liang, Lizzie Peiros, Michael C. Yip

Behavioral Cloning Mystery Manipulation

behavioral cloning robotic manipulation benchmark action chunking scripted policies OCBench

简要说明：本文提出了OCBench，一个利用可控脚本策略模拟人类演示的GPU加速机器人操作基准，用于复现和研究行为克隆中的谜题，如过拟合带来的性能提升以及缺乏动作分块时的失败现象。

TLDR: This paper introduces OCBench, a GPU-accelerated robotic manipulation benchmark with controllable scripted policies that mimic human demonstrations, to reproduce and study behavioral cloning mysteries such as overfitting benefits and failure without action chunking.

Abstract: Behavioral cloning (BC), despite its simplicity, exhibits many counterintuitive phenomena in the real world. For example, the performance of BC often keeps increasing as the model overfits more to the dataset, and fully closed-loop policies often completely fail without action chunking. Unfortunately, properly studying these anecdotal phenomena ("behavioral cloning mysteries") is challenging: in the real world, datasets and experiments are costly and not fully controllable; in simulation with synthetic data, these phenomena are often not easily observed partly due to the discrepancy between scripted policies and human demonstrations. In this work, we propose OCBench, a robotic manipulation benchmark with controllable scripted policies that have similar properties to human demonstrations. We show that, by mimicking key properties of human demonstrations, OCBench reproduces many anecdotal BC-related phenomena in controlled settings. With its GPU-accelerated environments and scripted policies, we demonstrate how OCBench enables scientific studies of previously reported BC-related phenomena by analyzing and refuting various hypotheses. Project page: https://seohong.me/projects/ocbench

摘要（中文）：行为克隆（BC）尽管方法简单，但在现实世界中却展现出许多反直觉的现象。例如，随着模型对数据集的过拟合程度加深，BC的性能往往持续提升；而完全闭环的策略在没有动作分块的情况下，常常完全失效。遗憾的是，恰当地研究这些轶事性现象（“行为克隆之谜”）颇具挑战：在现实世界中，数据集的获取与实验成本高昂且无法完全可控；在采用合成数据的仿真环境中，这些现象往往不易观察到，部分原因在于脚本化策略与人类示教之间的差异。在本工作中，我们提出了OCBench，一个配备可控脚本化策略的机器人操作基准，这些策略具有与人类示教相似的性质。我们表明，通过模拟人类示教的关键特性，OCBench能够在受控环境中复现许多轶事性的BC相关现象。借助其GPU加速的环境与脚本化策略，我们展示了OCBench如何通过分析与反驳各种假设，实现对先前报道的BC相关现象的科学化研究。项目页面：https://seohong.me/projects/ocbench

Authors: Seohong Park, Sergey Levine

Controllable Road Marking Generation AutonomousDriving

road marking generation bird's-eye-view rectified-flow DiT Gaussian rendering map completion

简要说明：本文提出了一种可控道路标线生成框架，通过文本条件和结构化高斯渲染从可行驶区域掩码合成缺失的中心区域标线，在Argoverse 2和Waymo数据集上取得了高精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces a controllable road marking generation framework that synthesizes missing center-region markings from drivable-area masks and text descriptions using a text-conditioned DiT and structured Gaussian rendering, achieving high accuracy on Argoverse 2 and Waymo datasets.

Abstract: Lane and road markings provide critical guidance for vehicle navigation and multi-agent coordination, yet authoring them at scale remains a manual workflow that limits quantitative analysis and scenario testing. We introduce Controllable Road Marking Generation, which synthesizes a missing center-region marking layout from a drivable-area mask, optional outer-ring markings, and a textual description. Our benchmark uses deterministic, metadata-derived prompts and three output channels: lane dividers, road dividers, and pedestrian crossings. We develop a conditional bird's-eye-view (BEV) pipeline that combines (i) a text-conditioned latent rectified-flow DiT trained with a topology-aware auxiliary loss, (ii) Gaussian-blurred training targets that stabilize learning of thin, sparse markings, and (iii) Structured Gaussian Render (SGR), a training-free post-process that recovers crisp divider geometry by extracting polylines, fitting cubic Bézier curves, and re-rendering them as anisotropic super-Gaussian primitives. On 4,597 Argoverse~2 test tiles, our system achieves Buffered F1 of 80.8 and clDice of 50.2, compared with 38.8 and 24.6 for an adapted state-of-the-art mask-refinement baseline. On Waymo dataset, it yields 88.0 Buffered F1 and 66.2 clDice. Component ablations show complementary connectivity gains from topology-aware supervision and SGR. Text-editing experiments reveal that stronger guidance improves edit success but also increases changes to non-target structures. We see this framework as a step toward simulation-ready road-marking variation, automated map completion, and early-stage infrastructure design exploration.

摘要（中文）：车道和道路标线为车辆导航和多智能体协同提供关键引导，然而大规模绘制这些标线仍依赖人工流程，限制了定量分析和场景测试的开展。我们提出可控道路标线生成方法，该方法能够从可行驶区域掩码、可选的外圈标线以及文本描述中合成缺失的中心区域标线布局。我们的基准测试采用确定性的、基于元数据的提示词，并包含三个输出通道：车道分隔线、道路分隔线和人行横道。我们开发了一条条件鸟瞰图（BEV）流水线，其结合了：(i) 使用拓扑感知辅助损失训练、以文本为条件的潜在整流流扩散变换器（DiT）；(ii) 经高斯模糊处理的训练目标，以稳定细薄稀疏标线的学习；(iii) 结构化高斯渲染（SGR），一种无需训练的后处理模块，通过提取折线、拟合三次贝塞尔曲线并将其重新渲染为各向异性超高斯图元，恢复清晰的分隔线几何形状。在4，597个Argoverse 2测试瓦片上，我们的系统实现了80.8的Buffered F1和50.2的clDice，而适配的现有最优掩码细化基线仅达到38.8和24.6。在Waymo数据集上，其分别达到88.0的Buffered F1和66.2的clDice。组件消融实验表明，拓扑感知监督与SGR带来了互补的连通性提升。文本编辑实验揭示，更强的引导能够提高编辑成功率，但也增加了对非目标结构的改动。我们认为该框架是迈向仿真就绪的道路标线变体生成、自动化地图补全以及早期基础设施设计探索的一步。

Authors: Zhiyu, Cai, Yufan Zhang, Ruichen Tan, Zengxiang Lei, Satish Ukkusuri

Bilinear Flow Policy: Distributional Extrapolation for Goal-Conditioned Visuomotor Imitation Manipulation

Goal-conditioned imitation learning Flow matching Distributional extrapolation Visuomotor policy Transductive retrieval

简要说明：本文提出了双线性流策略（BFP），一种生成式视觉运动策略，通过转导检索和双线性条件流实现目标条件模仿学习中未见目标的分布外泛化，在仿真和真实操作任务中取得了显著的分布外成功率提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces Bilinear Flow Policy (BFP), a generative visuomotor policy that uses transductive retrieval and a bilinear conditional flow to extrapolate to unseen goals in goal-conditioned imitation learning, achieving significant out-of-distribution success gains in simulation and real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Goal-conditioned imitation learning (GCIL) with flow matching is a promising framework that can represent multimodal behaviors while adapting to diverse, user-specified goals, yet often fails when goals lie outside the demonstration support. To extrapolate to such unseen goals without collapsing multimodality - a problem we call distributional extrapolation - we introduce Bilinear Flow Policy (BFP), a generative visuomotor policy that combines transductive retrieval with a bilinear conditional flow. Given an unseen observation-goal pair, BFP retrieves an "anchor" training example and transductively reformulates the unseen pair as this familiar anchor plus a residual term. For this decomposition to guide action prediction, the residual must compactly encode how the current observation-goal pair differs from the anchor, and the anchor must be chosen so that this difference is predictive of the corresponding action distribution. BFP achieves this with pretrained visual features and a novel learned anchor-selection algorithm. The novel bilinear flow then models how the anchor and the residual jointly determine the multimodal action distribution. We prove that, for bilinear flow under suitable assumptions, action distribution error at unseen goals is bounded by the in-distribution flow-matching error up to problem-dependent factors. Across five manipulation tasks in simulation, BFP achieves 2.63x the out-of distribution success rate of a GCIL policy and 1.36x that of the strongest extrapolation-targeted baseline. On two real-world tasks, BFP improves over GCIL by 32%. Finally, our theory yields practical, pre deployment diagnostics for predicting which trained policies will extrapolate well and to which unseen goal.

摘要（中文）：目标条件模仿学习（GCIL）结合流匹配是一种有前景的框架，能够表征多模态行为，同时适应多样化的、用户指定的目标，但当目标位于演示支持范围之外时，该框架往往失效。为了在不破坏多模态性的前提下外推到此类未见目标——我们将这一问题称为分布外推——我们引入了双线性流策略（BFP），一种将转导检索与双线性条件流相结合的生成式视觉运动策略。给定一对未见过的观测-目标组合，BFP 会检索一个“锚点”训练样例，并将该未见组合转导性地重构为这一熟悉锚点加上一个残差项。为使这一分解能够指导动作预测，残差必须紧凑地编码当前观测-目标组合与锚点之间的差异，并且锚点的选择必须使得该差异能够预测对应的动作分布。BFP 通过预训练的视觉特征和一种新颖的学习式锚点选择算法实现这一目标。所提出的双线性流随后建模锚点与残差如何共同决定多模态动作分布。我们证明，在适当假设下，对于双线性流，未见目标处的动作分布误差受分布内流匹配误差的约束，仅受问题相关因子的影响。在仿真中的五个操作任务上，BFP 的分布外成功率是 GCIL 策略的 2.63 倍，是针对性外推最强基线的 1.36 倍。在两个真实世界任务中，BFP 相比 GCIL 提升了 32%。最后，我们的理论为部署前诊断提供了实用工具，可用于预测哪些训练后的策略能够良好地外推，以及针对哪些未见目标能够有效外推。

Authors: Wonsuhk Jung, Sundhar Vinodh Sangeetha, Chen Xu, Abhishek Gupta, Masha Itkina, Shreyas Kousik, Haruki Nishimura

Demonstration-Calibrated Port-Hamiltonian Retuning for Manipulation Policies Manipulation

port-Hamiltonian impedance control diffusion policy VLA manipulation

简要说明：该论文提出PHRetune，一种离线方法，通过端口-哈密顿模型和示教能量预算自动调整冻结操作策略的下游阻抗控制器增益，在LIBERO和真实任务中提升扩散策略和VLA策略的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces PHRetune, an offline method that automatically tunes impedance controller gains for frozen manipulation policies by leveraging port-Hamiltonian models and demonstration-derived energy/effort budgets, improving success on LIBERO and real-world tasks with Diffusion and VLA policies.

Abstract: Diffusion and VLA policies for manipulation are often deployed through downstream impedance controllers. The stiffness and damping gains of these controllers affect task success, yet are commonly inherited from data collection rather than selected for the deployed policy. Although empirical gain sweeps can improve performance, they require repeated evaluation rollouts. We introduce PHRetune, an offline method that derives controller gains for a frozen policy without evaluation rollouts or gain search. Our approach learns a port-Hamiltonian model from demonstrations to estimate the effort and energy associated with the policy's predicted actions. The policy is applied to recorded demonstration observations, and its predictions are assessed against demonstration-derived effort and energy budgets. From this comparison, we derive a single gain scale in closed form, adjusting the downstream controller while preserving the policy and its action representation. The gains are fixed before evaluation, without requiring a prior manipulator model, task rewards, policy retraining, or additional runtime computation. Across LIBERO suites, PHRetune improves Diffusion Policy success by up to 9.4 percentage points, with the derived gains achieving the highest observed success rates in empirical gain sweeps. On all four real-world manipulation tasks, PHRetuned Diffusion Policy outperforms the nominal policy, alternative gain-tuning methods, and a policy-retraining baseline. The same procedure improves success with SmolVLA and OpenVLA-OFT on every task, while reducing acceleration and jerk for both VLA backbones.

摘要（中文）：扩散模型和VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略在操控任务中通常通过下游阻抗控制器进行部署。这些控制器的刚度和阻尼增益会影响任务成功率，但往往继承自数据采集过程，而非针对所部署策略进行选择。尽管经验性的增益扫描可以提升性能，但需要反复进行评估 rollout。我们提出 PHRetune，一种无需评估 rollout 或增益搜索即可为固定策略推导控制器增益的离线方法。该方法从示范中学习一个端口-哈密顿模型，以估计策略预测动作所对应的力和能量。将策略应用于记录的示范观测数据，并依据示范推导的力和能量预算对其预测进行评估。通过这一比较，我们以闭式解形式推导出单一增益尺度，在保持策略及其动作表示不变的前提下调整下游控制器。增益在评估前即已固定，无需先验机械臂模型、任务奖励、策略重训练或额外运行时计算。在 LIBERO 基准套件上，PHRetune 将 Diffusion Policy 的成功率最高提升 9.4 个百分点，且推导的增益在经验性增益扫描中达到最高观测成功率。在所有四个真实世界操控任务上，PHRetuned Diffusion Policy 均优于名义策略、其他增益调优方法以及策略重训练基线。同一方法在每项任务上均提升了 SmolVLA 和 OpenVLA-OFT 的成功率，同时降低了两种 VLA 主干网络的加速度和加加速度。
