The Unexpired Plan: A Free Monitor for Accelerated Diffusion Policies RLRobot

diffusion policy training-free acceleration monitor closed-loop success compute reduction

简要说明：本文提出无需训练的监控器，利用内部相似性信号认证捷径等价性，加速扩散策略；在114种配置及多个策略族上验证了保持闭环任务性能的同时显著降低单次调用计算。

TLDR: This paper introduces a training-free monitor that accelerates diffusion policies by reusing internal similarity signals to certify shortcut equivalence, demonstrating across 114 configurations and multiple policy families that the monitor preserves closed-loop task performance while cutting per-call compute significantly.

Abstract: Training-free acceleration of a diffusion policy is accepted when an internal similarity signal reports that the shortcut changed nothing. We price every monitor a control loop can afford in closed-loop success rather than feature distance, over $114$ accelerator configurations and four policy families: two accelerators each clear their own gate's bar and log every reuse as certified, while on one task one finishes every episode and the other none. A monitor is two designs, not one --- the statistic it reads, and what it does when that statistic fires. Published gates re-arm after every rejection, and under that response even an oracle handed every forward pass and the exact local action error loses twenty points; absorbing the same statistic costs one point, and most of its speed. What makes a response that never forgets affordable is a statistic that rarely fires, and what it must measure is deviation from the policy the accelerator replaced --- which a chunked policy has already paid for, its last plan not yet expired and free to read. Guarding every call this way cuts per-call compute by $1.55$--$3.09\times$, where any reference-requiring check at the same coverage would have to stop accelerating altogether. On three of our four families the schedule alone already holds the pre-stated $\pm2$-point margin. What the monitor is measurably worth shows in three places: on the fourth family, where it rescues the candidate selection landed on; on four configurations it did not select; and on a contact-rich fifth family, chosen where the schedule was expected to fail and run after every design choice was frozen, where no unmonitored arm at its speed holds the margin and the monitored one does.

摘要（中文）：免训练加速扩散策略在内部相似性信号报告捷径未改变任何内容时被接受。我们对每个监控器在闭环成功率而非特征距离上进行定价，涵盖$114$种加速器配置和四个策略族：两个加速器各自通过自身门控的阈值，并将每次复用记录为已认证，而在一个任务上，其中一个完成了所有回合，另一个则一个未完成。监控器是两个设计而非一个——它读取的统计量，以及当该统计量触发时它所采取的行动。已发布的门控在每次拒绝后重新武装，在这种响应下，即使将每次前向传播和精确的局部动作误差交给一个神谕，也会损失二十分；而吸收相同的统计量仅损失一分，且大部分速度得以保留。使一种永不遗忘的响应变得可负担的是极少触发的统计量，而它必须衡量的是与加速器所替代策略的偏差——分块策略已为此付出代价，其最后的计划尚未过期，可免费读取。以此方式守护每次调用，使每次调用的计算量减少$1.55$–$3.09\times$，而任何在相同覆盖范围内需要参考的检查都将不得不完全停止加速。在我们的四个策略族中的三个上，仅凭调度就已保持预先声明的$\pm2$分余量。监控器的可衡量价值体现在三个方面：在第四个策略族上，它挽救了候选选择所落到的结果；在四个它未选择的配置上；以及在一个接触丰富的第五个策略族上，该策略族选在调度预期失败之处，并在所有设计选择冻结后运行，在那里，没有监控的分支在其速度下无法保持余量，而受监控的分支则做到了。

Authors: Yi Zhao, Sebastian Scherer

End-to-End Safe Social Navigation via Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning and Probabilistic Perception RLRobot

social navigation multi-task reinforcement learning probabilistic perception end-to-end LiDAR

简要说明：JESSI是一个轻量级端到端强化学习框架，将原始LiDAR扫描映射到控制命令以实现安全的社交导航，利用Dirichlet参数化动作空间和基于注意力的感知模块进行概率性人类状态估计，并在仿真和真实机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: JESSI is a lightweight end-to-end RL framework that maps raw LiDAR scans to control commands for safe social navigation, using Dirichlet-parameterized action spaces and attention-based perception for probabilistic human state estimation, validated in simulation and on a real robot.

Abstract: Autonomous social navigation requires balancing efficiency, physical safety, and social compliance. Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods provide a viable and effective solution but often rely on unrealistic assumptions, such as the knowledge of humans' position and velocity. In this paper, we introduce JESSI (JAX-based E2E Safe Social Interpretable navigation), a lightweight end-to-end RL framework that maps raw LiDAR scans directly to kinematically feasible control commands. JESSI enhances safety via Dirichlet-parameterized continuous action spaces and deterministic bounding, while an integrated attention-based perception module extracts probabilistic human states for interpretable, socially aware decision-making. Through extensive simulations and real-world deployment on a differential-drive robot, we demonstrate that jointly optimizing the RL policy with a supervised perception signal in a multi-task paradigm enhances social behavior. Ultimately, JESSI is able to balance high navigation success rates and superior social behaviors compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

摘要（中文）：自主社交导航需要在效率、物理安全与社会合规之间取得平衡。强化学习（RL）方法提供了一种可行且有效的解决方案，但往往依赖于不切实际的假设，例如对行人位置和速度的已知。在本文中，我们介绍了JESSI（基于JAX的端到端安全社交可解释导航）——一个轻量级端到端强化学习框架，可将原始激光雷达扫描直接映射为运动学可行的控制指令。JESSI通过狄利克雷参数化的连续动作空间和确定性边界增强安全性，同时集成的基于注意力的感知模块提取概率性人体状态，以实现可解释的、具备社交意识的决策。通过大量仿真以及在差速驱动机器人上的实际部署，我们证明在多任务范式中将强化学习策略与监督感知信号联合优化能够增强社交行为。最终，与最先进的基线方法相比，JESSI能够在高导航成功率与优越社交行为之间取得平衡。

Authors: Tommaso Van Der Meer, Andrea Garulli, Antonio Giannitrapani, Renato Quartullo, Alberto Vaglio, Alexandre Alahi

Virtual model control for compliant reaching under uncertainties HumanoidEmbodied

Virtual Model Control reaching tasks force-controlled robot uncertainties physical humanoid robot

简要说明：本文将虚拟模型控制应用于力控机械臂的到达任务，在不确定环境中提出六种虚拟模型设计，并在真实8自由度人形机器人上验证其应对障碍和不确定性的能力。

TLDR: This paper applies Virtual Model Control to force-controlled robotic arms for reaching tasks in uncertain environments, proposing six virtual model designs and validating them on a real 8-DOF humanoid robot to handle obstacles and uncertainties.

Abstract: Virtual Model Control (VMC) is an approach to design a controller for force-controlled robots in complex uncertain environments. While this method was primarily investigated for legged robot locomotion in the past, it can be more generally applicable to other types of robotic systems. This paper investigates the VMC framework for reaching tasks in a force-controlled robotic arm. We propose six different approaches to designing virtual models in order to achieve reaching tasks in environments with obstacles and uncertainties. A force-controlled 8 degree-of-freedom humanoid robot was used to validate the proposed approach in the real world. We conducted three experiments to test the performance of VMC controllers in terms of predictability, sensitivity to external force, and adaptability against known and unknown obstacles. Experimental analyses show that, even though the proposed approach needs to sacrifice accuracy and trajectory optimality, it enables us to design complex reaching motions under uncertainties, in an intuitive and extendable manner.

摘要（中文）：虚拟模型控制（VMC）是一种在复杂不确定环境中为力控机器人设计控制器的方法。尽管该方法过去主要被研究用于腿式机器人运动控制，但它可以更广泛地适用于其他类型的机器人系统。本文研究了VMC框架在力控机械臂到达任务中的应用。我们提出了六种不同的虚拟模型设计方法，以实现在存在障碍和不确定性的环境中完成到达任务。实验采用了一台力控的8自由度仿人机器人来验证所提方法的实际效果。我们进行了三项实验，以测试VMC控制器在可预测性、对外部力的敏感性以及对已知和未知障碍的适应性方面的性能。实验分析表明，尽管所提方法需要在精度和轨迹最优性上做出一定牺牲，但它使我们能够以直观且可扩展的方式，在不确定性条件下设计复杂的到达运动。

Authors: Yi Zhang, Daniel Larby, Fumiya Iida, Fulvio Forni

Benchmarking Generative Trajectory Models for Active-Inference Control Manipulation

generative trajectory models active inference diffusion CVAE MuJoCo manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了GenAIF，一种将生成式轨迹模型用于主动推理控制的框架，并在MuJoCo操作任务中对比了扩散、Transformer、CVAE和流匹配等模型。

TLDR: The paper introduces GenAIF, a control framework where a single generative trajectory model handles action proposals, prediction, and observation evidence for active inference, benchmarking diffusion, transformers, CVAEs, and flow matching in a MuJoCo manipulation task.

Abstract: Learning from trajectory demonstrations offers a route to active-inference control of complex systems whose dynamics are difficult to model explicitly. We introduce generative active-inference control (GenAIF), in which one generative trajectory model learns from demonstrations and measured action interventions to supply a goal-conditioned policy distribution and a state-to-observation likelihood mapping. From this control design, we derive three model requirements: (i) useful action proposals, (ii) accurate prediction under imposed actions, and (iii) probabilistic observation evidence for belief updating and expected information gain. We benchmark diffusion, autoregressive Transformers, conditional variational autoencoders (CVAEs), and flow matching in a MuJoCo manipulation task with multiple physical conditions. Diffusion delivers the strongest control across the tested dynamics, while CVAE combines comparable short-horizon prediction with much faster inference. Correct conditioning is decisive, and trajectory reuse offers further computational savings. With the same frozen models, a hidden-dynamics experiment demonstrates prompt belief adaptation after an unannounced tilt change; subsequent instability identifies sustained inference as a remaining challenge. These findings support the use of shared generative trajectory models to connect action proposal, controlled prediction, and observation evidence within GenAIF.

摘要（中文）：从轨迹示范中学习，为难以显式建模动力学的复杂系统提供了一条主动推理控制的途径。我们提出了生成式主动推理控制（GenAIF），其中单个生成式轨迹模型从示范及实测动作干预中学习，以提供目标条件策略分布及状态到观测的似然映射。基于这一控制设计，我们推导出三个模型要求：（i）有效的动作提议，（ii）在所施加动作下的准确预测，以及（iii）用于信念更新和预期信息增益的概率观测证据。我们在具有多种物理条件的MuJoCo操作任务中，对扩散模型、自回归Transformer、条件变分自编码器（CVAE）及流匹配进行了基准测试。在所测试的动力学条件下，扩散模型提供了最强的控制性能，而CVAE则结合了可比的短期预测能力与更快的推理速度。正确的条件设置至关重要，轨迹重用可进一步节省计算资源。在相同的冻结模型下，隐藏动力学实验展示了在未预先通知的倾斜变化后的快速信念适应；随后的不稳定性表明持续推理仍是待解决的挑战。这些发现支持使用共享生成式轨迹模型，在GenAIF中连接动作提议、受控预测及观测证据。

Authors: Yulin Li, Mohsen A. Jafari, Andrea Matta

Learning Coordinated Visuomotor Box-Pushing from Solo Demonstrations RLRobot

multi-robot imitation learning box-pushing decentralized policy solo demonstrations coordination

简要说明：本文研究了是否可以利用单机器人遥操作演示来训练多机器人去中心化推箱策略，并表明在多达40个机器人的实验中，仅通过被动观察无法实现有效协调。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether single-robot teleoperated demonstrations can be scaled to train multi-robot decentralized box-pushing policies, showing that passive observation alone is insufficient for coordination with up to 40 robots.

Abstract: Multi-robot imitation learning, particularly in settings where visuomotor policies are deployed in a communication-free, onboard decentralised style, represents an attractive paradigm. However, its realisation remains insufficiently understood, largely due to the difficulty of collecting collective demonstrations, since a single operator cannot control many robots simultaneously. Meanwhile, unlike coupled collaborative manipulation, many coordinated tasks achieve system-wide efficiency primarily through minimising inter-robot interference. This structure motivates us to study whether data collected by a teleoperated single-robot can be leveraged for large-scale coordinated box-pushing as a testbed. We systematically investigate dataset creation strategies and lightweight policy architectures. In particular, experiments with up to 40 robots highlight the difficulty of acquiring effective coordination solely through passive observation of other operating robots, revealing a concrete bottleneck for multi-robot research.

摘要（中文）：多机器人模仿学习，尤其是在无线通信受限、机载分散式部署视觉运动策略的场景下，展现出了极具吸引力的应用前景。然而，由于单一操作员难以同时操控多台机器人，导致集体示范数据的采集困难重重，该范式的实际落地尚存诸多未知。区别于紧密耦合的协作操作任务，众多协调任务主要通过最小化机器人间的相互干扰来提升系统整体效率。这一特性启发我们探索：能否利用遥操作单机器人采集的数据，作为大规模协同推箱任务的测试平台？我们系统研究了数据集构建策略与轻量化策略架构。实验结果显示，在多达40台机器人的规模下，仅通过被动观察其他运行中机器人的方式难以习得有效协同，这突显了多机器人研究中的具体瓶颈。

Authors: Ryusei Matsumoto, Mei Kinjo, Yoko Sasaki, Keisuke Okumura

StageVLN: Spatial and Trajectory Auxiliary Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation VLN

Vision-Language Navigation spatial guidance trajectory guidance geometry foundation model R2R-CE

简要说明：StageVLN 提出了一种仅训练时的框架，利用冻结的几何基础模型提供特权空间与轨迹辅助指导，在不增加推理时几何编码器的情况下提升视觉语言导航性能。

TLDR: StageVLN introduces a training-only framework that uses privileged spatial and trajectory auxiliary guidance from a frozen geometry foundation model to improve Vision-Language Navigation performance without adding inference-time geometry encoders.

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.

摘要（中文）：视觉与语言导航（VLN）策略日益受益于大型视觉语言模型（VLM）所提供的强语义先验。然而，标准的动作监督并未明确鼓励中间表示保留场景几何结构、相对朝向或整体情节进度。在推理阶段引入深度估计器、显式地图、点云或几何基础模型虽可提供此类结构信息，但会增加部署时的额外计算量、内存开销及架构依赖性。我们提出StageVLN，一种通过特权空间与轨迹引导塑造导航表示的训练框架，同时保持原有推理路径不变。冻结的几何基础模型为分层导航器状态提供多层级空间引导，而相对朝向与专家路径进度目标则提供互补的轨迹状态监督。所有辅助组件仅在训练阶段使用，部署时全部移除。在R2R-CE验证未见环境中，StageVLN使用4B参数主干网络取得了56.3%的成功率（SR）和51.4%的路径加权成功率（SPL），推理时无需额外的几何编码器。在RxR-CE上，StageVLN在无需额外导航训练数据或推理时几何编码器的情况下，取得了54.3%的SR。

Authors: Anh Dao, Quan-Dung Pham, Le Danh Vinh, The Anh Nguyen, Nguyen Viet Tri Pham, Yiyu Chen, Pham Tuyen Le, Van-Truong Nguyen, Quan Nguyen

FOCUS: Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Change Detection for Uncertainty-Aware Semi-Static Scenes Perception3D

change detection map maintenance 3D Gaussian Splatting uncertainty-aware semi-static scenes

简要说明：FOCUS 是一个针对半静态场景的、不确定性感知的对象级变化检测与地图维护框架，融合 3D 高斯地图的几何与外观似然，通过概率三状态估计器检测原位替换，在仓库基准上将替换 F1 从 0.20 提升至 0.84，并可直接迁移至真实世界数据。

TLDR: FOCUS is an uncertainty-aware framework for object-level change detection and map maintenance in semi-static scenes, fusing geometric and appearance likelihood from 3D Gaussian maps with a probabilistic three-state estimator to detect in-place replacements, improving replacement F1 from 0.20 to 0.84 in a warehouse benchmark and transferring to real-world data.

Abstract: Autonomous robots operating over long periods must keep their environmental memory up to date as the world changes between visits. In semi-static environments, an object may be replaced in place by a different but geometrically and semantically similar instance, making the identity change difficult to detect from geometry or coarse semantics alone. We present FOCUS, an uncertainty-aware framework for object-level change detection and map maintenance. We formulate semi-static memory maintenance as probabilistic inference that fuses geometric likelihood with appearance likelihood rendered from a 3D Gaussian map. A recursive three-state estimator maintains whether each mapped object is PERSISTED, REPLACED, or REMOVED. To account for imperfect 3DGS rendering, we model the rendered appearance evidence probabilistically rather than using it as a direct change score, with the model parameters automatically calibrated from a change-free replay of the initial mapping session. We evaluate our method on a new Isaac Sim warehouse benchmark with ambiguous in-place replacements and on the real-world TorWIC dataset. It improves object-level replacement F1 from 0.20 to 0.84 over a probabilistic baseline and transfers to real-world data without manual parameter retuning.

摘要（中文）：自主机器人在长时间运行过程中，必须随着环境在访问之间的变化，持续更新其环境记忆。在半静态环境中，物体可能会被另一个在几何和语义上相似但不同的实例原位替换，这使得仅凭几何或粗略语义难以检测身份变化。我们提出FOCUS，一种面向物体级变化检测与地图维护的不确定性感知框架。我们将半静态记忆维护形式化为概率推断，融合几何似然与从3D高斯地图渲染的外观似然。一个递归的三状态估计器维护每个已映射物体的状态，分别为持续存在、被替换或已移除。为应对3DGS渲染的不完美性，我们将渲染的外观证据建模为概率形式，而非直接用作变化分数，模型参数通过初始建图会话的无变化回放自动校准。我们在新的Isaac Sim仓库基准（包含模糊的原位替换场景）以及真实世界的TorWIC数据集上评估了该方法。相比概率基线，该方法将物体级替换的F1分数从0.20提升至0.84，并且无需手动参数调整即可迁移至真实数据。

Authors: Can Xu, Mingfeng Yuan, Mahan Mohammadi, Steven L. Waslander

TacGELLO: Tactile Contact Feedback for a 3D-Printed Teleoperation Leader Manipulation

teleoperation tactile feedback 3D-printed leader haptic feedback grasp precision

简要说明：TacGELLO利用现有舵机和电流负载反馈增强3D打印遥操作主手，提供触觉接触反馈，提高远程抓取精度并传递负载信息。

TLDR: TacGELLO enhances a 3D-printed teleoperation leader with tactile contact feedback using existing servos and current-based load cues, improving grasp precision and providing haptic feedback during remote manipulation.

Abstract: Passive leader arms transmit an operator's motion without returning remote contact or load cues. TacGELLO uses the existing servos of a 3D-printed leader for tactile contact feedback at the gripper trigger and current-based load cues at the arm joints. AnySkin contact detection activates a trigger position hold, while changes in follower joint current adjust leader-servo output limits to command resistance during lifting. Across six UR3 sessions with one operator, sent-command tracking error was 0.15--0.36$^\circ$ RMSE, with estimated trajectory lag of 82--98\,ms. Tactile onset was logged in 60 of 62 segmented TacGELLO grasp intervals. Median commanded closure after tactile or width-based contact references was 0.7--2.1\,mm with TacGELLO and 13.0--13.9\,mm with the original interface.

摘要（中文）：被动式主手臂在传递操作者运动时，不返回远端接触力或负载提示。TacGELLO利用3D打印主手臂上现有的伺服机构，在夹爪扳机处提供触觉接触反馈，并在手臂关节处提供基于电流的负载提示。AnySkin接触检测会触发扳机位置保持，而跟随关节电流的变化会调整主手伺服输出限值，从而在抬升过程中指令阻力。 在六次UR3操作者会话中，发送指令的跟踪误差为0.15–0.36°均方根误差，估计轨迹延迟为82–98毫秒。在62个分割的TacGELLO抓取区间中，有60个记录了触觉触发的开始。在触觉或宽度基准接触参考后，带TacGELLO的中位指令闭合量为0.7–2.1毫米，而原始接口为13.0–13.9毫米。

Authors: Younsoo Kim, Sangmin Song, Sarath Kodagoda, Marc Carmichael, Karthick Thiyagarajan

Robust 2D Traversability Mapping for Construction AMRs via Failure-Mode-Aware Fusion of LiDAR Geometry and Monocular Semantics Perception3D

traversability mapping LiDAR monocular semantics failure-mode-aware fusion construction AMR

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于建筑自主移动机器人的实时、故障模式感知可通行性映射系统，该系统融合LiDAR几何和单目语义分割，以纠正常见的互补性故障并增强导航安全性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a real-time, failure-mode-aware traversability mapping system for construction AMRs that fuses LiDAR geometry with monocular semantic segmentation to correct complementary failure modes and improve navigation safety.

Abstract: Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) on active construction sites face severe navigational challenges: geometry-based traversability mapping (e.g., LiDAR) misses visually hazardous but geometrically flat surfaces like wet mud and ponding concrete, while abrupt geometry on drivable speed-breakers and inclines produces phantom obstacles. We propose a real-time, failure-mode-aware multimodal traversability pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, where LiDAR is the primary geometric safety estimate and monocular semantics act as a selective, class- and confidence-gated corrective signal. The representation retains distinct traversable classes, namely flat road, terrain, and rocky terrain, while flagging construction hazards. We also release a multimodal construction-site dataset from a custom AMR: four closed-loop ROS 2 sequences from two active sites (RGB, depth, LiDAR, IMU, GPS-RTK, odometry) plus 506 annotated frames across 28 semantic classes. By projecting LiDAR onto dense semantic masks, resolving sparsity via morphological in-painting, and applying failure-mode-aware fusion with Patchwork++, the system corrects complementary geometric failure modes for a local AMR costmap.

摘要（中文）：自主移动机器人在活跃建筑工地上面临着严峻的导航挑战：基于几何的可通行性建图（如激光雷达）会遗漏湿泥和积水混凝土等视觉上危险但几何平坦的表面，而可行驶减速带和坡道上的突兀几何特征则会产生虚假障碍。我们提出了一种在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上运行的实时、故障模式感知的多模态可通行性处理管线，其中激光雷达作为主要几何安全估计，单目语义信息则作为选择性、类别与置信度门控的校正信号。该表示保留了不同的可通行类别，即平坦道路、地形和岩石地形，同时标记建筑危险区域。我们还发布了一个来自定制自主移动机器人的多模态建筑工地数据集：来自两个活跃工地的四个闭环ROS 2序列（RGB、深度、激光雷达、IMU、GPS-RTK、里程计），以及包含28个语义类别共506帧的标注图像。通过将激光雷达投影到密集语义掩膜上，利用形态学修复解决稀疏性问题，并结合Patchwork++进行故障模式感知融合，该系统为局部自主移动机器人代价地图校正了互补的几何故障模式。

Authors: Manoj Karnekar, Om Mandhane, Gautham Ramkumar

PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence VLA

interactive visual intelligence video games closed-loop interaction Video-LLM-as-a-judge perception-action gap

简要说明：PlaySuite 提出了一个包含 5,000 多个视频游戏的大规模基准，用于评估交互式视觉智能，揭示了当前视觉语言、计算机使用和视觉语言动作模型中的感知-行动差距。

TLDR: PlaySuite introduces a large-scale benchmark of 5K+ video games to evaluate interactive visual intelligence, revealing a perception-action gap in current vision-language, computer-use, and vision-language-action models.

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models yield strong performance on static perception and reasoning benchmarks, yet such evaluations largely overlook a central aspect of intelligence: acting competently in dynamic environments over extended time horizons. We introduce PlaySuite, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating interactive visual intelligence across more than 5K open-source video games curated from PyWeek and itch.io. Spanning diverse genres and engines, including Pygame, HTML5, Godot, and Unity, these independent games are largely out-of-distribution for current models, reducing the likelihood that success can be achieved by retrieving memorized walkthroughs or web-scale training artifacts. To enable scalable evaluation across heterogeneous titles, we develop a unified closed-loop interaction framework optimized for HPC clusters alongside a Video-LLM-as-a-judge protocol that maps observable gameplay milestones to standardized progress levels. We evaluate fourteen recent open models spanning vision-language models, computer-use agents, and vision-language-action models. Our results yield strong evidence of a perception-action gap: despite strong reasoning capabilities, current models struggle to make sustained progress and exhibit recurring failures in spatial grounding, action execution, and self-correction. PlaySuite provides a reproducible and extensible testbed for measuring progress from visual perception to goal-directed interaction, and a foundation for developing models that can act, adapt, and generalize in dynamic visual environments.

摘要（中文）：近期在多模态基础模型方面的进展，在静态感知和推理基准测试中表现出色，然而此类评估在很大程度上忽略了一个核心智能维度，即在动态环境中长时间跨度内胜任行动的能力。我们推出了PlaySuite，这是一个大规模基准测试，旨在评估超过5000个从PyWeek和itch.io精选的开源视频游戏中的交互式视觉智能。这些独立游戏涵盖多种类型和引擎，包括Pygame、HTML5、Godot和Unity，对于当前模型而言大多属于分布外数据，从而降低了通过检索记忆中的攻略或网络规模训练产物取得成功的可能性。为了在不同类型的游戏之间实现可扩展评估，我们开发了一套针对HPC集群优化的统一闭环交互框架，以及一种视频-大语言模型作为裁判的协议，该协议将可观察的游戏进程里程碑映射为标准化的进度等级。我们评估了十四个近期发布的开放模型，涵盖视觉-语言模型、计算机使用智能体以及视觉-语言-行动模型。我们的结果有力证明了感知-行动差距的存在：尽管推理能力强，当前模型仍难以取得持续进展，并在空间定位、行动执行和自我纠错方面表现出反复出现的失败。PlaySuite为衡量从视觉感知到目标导向交互的进展提供了一个可复现且可扩展的测试平台，也为开发能够在动态视觉环境中行动、适应和泛化的模型奠定了基础。

Authors: Dheeraj Varghese, Anna Vettoruzzo, Walter Simoncini, Michelle Lorena Acevedo Callejas, Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani, Kristof Meding, Joaquin Vanschoren, Cees G. M. Snoek

Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control WorldModel

asynchronous execution world-model control TD-MPC2 DreamerV3 action-semantic mismatch

简要说明：本文研究了异步执行下世界模型控制器中的动作语义错配，并针对 TD-MPC2 和 DreamerV3 提出了无需重新训练的轻量级修正接口。

TLDR: This paper identifies and corrects action-semantic mismatches in world-model controllers under asynchronous execution, proposing lightweight interfaces for TD-MPC2 and DreamerV3 without retraining.

Abstract: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied. Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it. Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models. Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.

摘要（中文）：世界模型控制器依赖动作条件动力学进行预测与规划，然而在实际控制系统中，由于通信延迟、数据包丢失、乱序以及执行器缓冲等原因，命令往往以异步方式被执行。本研究关注的不仅仅是异步执行作为外部控制扰动的影响，而是深入探讨其如何改变世界模型控制器中所假设的动作语义。通过受控干预实验，我们识别出两种依赖架构的失效模式：基于规划的控制器（如TD-MPC2）在想象与执行的动作序列之间存在未来动作时间线错配；而循环世界模型（如DreamerV3）则可能将观测到的状态转移错误归因于并未实际施加的命令。分析表明，TD-MPC2在潜在动力学展开过程中需要正确的未来动作序列，而DreamerV3则需要每个状态转移能及时归因于产生该转移的实际动作。基于上述发现，我们提出了两种轻量级的执行一致性接口——针对TD-MPC2的未来序列接口和针对DreamerV3的实际动作反馈接口——在不修改预训练世界模型的前提下纠正这些错配。在多种延迟条件、数据包丢失、乱序场景、多个控制域、实测网络轨迹以及进程分离的异步栈上的实验，均一致支持上述诊断结果及相应的架构特定修正方案。

Authors: Shengtao Wen, Xiang Chen, Yu Tian, Lingbing Guo, Lina Gong, Sheng-Jun Huang

Analysis of SWIR Imaging Detection Performance Under Adverse Environmental Conditions for Autonomous Driving Systems AutonomousDriving

SWIR imaging object detection adverse weather sensor fusion autonomous driving

简要说明：本文系统比较了自动驾驶中SWIR与RGB在恶劣条件下的目标检测性能，发现RGB总体更优，但SWIR在罕见的安全关键场景中具有优势，并提出了一种传感器主导性挖掘框架。

TLDR: This paper systematically compares SWIR vs RGB object detection for autonomous driving under adverse conditions, finding RGB generally superior but SWIR beneficial in rare safety-critical scenarios, and proposes a sensor-dominance mining framework.

Abstract: Short-wave infrared (SWIR) imaging has emerged as a promising modality for autonomous driving, yet its practical benefits over RGB remain poorly characterized across diverse conditions. This paper presents a systematic comparative study of paired RGB and SWIR object detection on the RASMD dataset, covering four weather conditions and two real-time detection architectures, with various fine-tunings evaluated against a unified ground truth. Overall, RGB demonstrates comparable or superior performance in most scenarios, while RF-DETR exhibits greater robustness across varying conditions. Beyond aggregate metrics, we propose a sensor-dominance mining framework that combines multi-model agreement with targeted manual inspection to identify scenarios where one sensing modality provides more reliable detections using largely unannotated paired data. This analysis reveals that SWIR offers clear advantages in four safety-critical situations, including windshield glare, water droplets on the windshield, low-contrast object visibility, and long-range vehicle detection. The findings suggest that SWIR should be viewed as a complementary modality that enhances perception in rare but challenging conditions. The datasets will be available upon request, and all code and trained model weights are publicly released at https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis.

摘要（中文）：短波红外（SWIR）成像已成为自动驾驶领域中一种前景广阔的技术手段，然而，其在多样环境条件下相较于RGB的实际优势仍未得到充分表征。本文基于RASMD数据集，对配对的RGB与SWIR目标检测进行了系统性比较研究，涵盖四种天气条件和两种实时检测架构，并在统一真值基准下评估了多种微调策略。总体而言，RGB在大多数场景中表现出与SWIR相当或更优的性能，而RF-DETR在不同条件下则展现出更强的鲁棒性。除总体指标外，本文提出了一种传感器主导性挖掘框架，将多模型一致性分析与针对性人工检查相结合，利用大量未标注的配对数据识别出某一感知模态能提供更可靠检测结果的场景。分析表明，SWIR在四类安全关键情境中具有明显优势，包括挡风玻璃眩光、挡风玻璃上的水珠、低对比度物体可见性以及远距离车辆检测。研究结果表明，SWIR应被视为一种补充性模态，能够在罕见但具有挑战性的条件下增强感知能力。数据集可根据请求提供，所有代码及训练好的模型权重均已公开，见https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis。

Authors: Rohan Mehra, Alexandre Riffard, Yannis Loumouamou, Mathieu Labussière

Difference Feature Map Distillation: Transferring Inter-Sample Relational Knowledge Towards Efficient Transformer-Based Tracking AutonomousDriving

knowledge distillation visual object tracking transformer relational distillation autonomous driving perception

简要说明：本文提出DFM-KD，一种针对基于Transformer的视觉目标跟踪的关系知识蒸馏方法，通过传递教师模型样本间特征差异来提升学生模型的跟踪精度和成功率，同时降低计算开销，适用于自动驾驶感知。

TLDR: This paper proposes DFM-KD, a relational knowledge distillation method for transformer-based visual object tracking that transfers inter-sample feature differences from a teacher to a student model, improving tracking precision and success rate while reducing computational overhead for autonomous driving perception.

Abstract: In autonomous driving perception, visual object tracking systems must satisfy stringent latency and power constraints while remaining robust in complex and dynamic environments. Although transformer-based trackers achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, their substantial computational and memory overheads hinder deployment on real-time, resource-constrained platforms. To move toward this goal, we propose Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation (DFM-KD), a novel relational distillation framework tailored for transformer-based visual object tracking. Unlike conventional feature distillation methods that minimize point-wise discrepancies (e.g., mean squared error) between teacher and student feature representations, DFM-KD transfers knowledge through inter-sample feature differences, explicitly aligning the relational structure of the feature space. By distilling how the teacher models appearance variation and consistency across samples, rather than enforcing similarity in absolute activations, DFM-KD enables the student to better capture the structural dynamics of visual changes within a batch. As a result, the distilled model exhibits enhanced feature robustness and improved tracking performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DFM-KD consistently outperforms conventional feature-level distillation methods in both tracking precision and success rates.

摘要（中文）：在自动驾驶感知领域，视觉目标跟踪系统必须在满足严格延迟和功耗限制的同时，在复杂动态环境中保持鲁棒性。尽管基于Transformer的跟踪器达到了最先进的精度，但其庞大的计算和内存开销阻碍了其在实时、资源受限平台上的部署。为推进这一目标，我们提出差分特征图知识蒸馏（DFM-KD），一种专为基于Transformer的视觉目标跟踪设计的新型关系蒸馏框架。与传统的特征蒸馏方法（如最小化教师和学生特征表示之间逐点差异的均方误差）不同，DFM-KD通过样本间的特征差异传递知识，明确对齐特征空间的关系结构。通过蒸馏教师模型如何建模样本间外观变化与一致性，而非强制绝对激活值的相似性，DFM-KD使学生模型能够更好地捕捉批内视觉变化的结构动态。因此，蒸馏后的模型展现出增强的特征鲁棒性和改进的跟踪性能。大量实验表明，DFM-KD在跟踪精度和成功率上均持续优于传统特征级蒸馏方法。

Authors: Zhicheng Ding, Xinyu Chu, Qing Tian

When Low Prediction Error Misleads Planning: Diagnosing Representation, Dynamics, and Decision Failures in Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models prediction error planning action selection representation learning

简要说明：本文研究了控制任务中的潜在世界模型，发现主导预测误差的组件未必是修正后最能改善动作选择的组件，从而促使对表示、预测和规划各阶段进行独立评估。

TLDR: This paper investigates latent world models in control tasks, finding that the component dominating prediction error is not always the one whose correction most benefits action selection, motivating separate evaluation of representation, prediction, and planning stages.

Abstract: The component that dominates a latent world model's prediction error need not be the one whose repair most improves action selection. We show this by comparing action sequences from identical physical starts and separating endpoint error into a candidate-pool center and action-relative responses. Across four model families and four tasks, a confirmation pool of 256 new starts per task and 300 shared candidates per start shows that center error dominates MSE in 14/16 model-task cells. Yet in six of these cells, an oracle that corrects only the action-relative responses yields better physical rank correlation and top-30 elite quality than one that corrects only the center, while leaving more latent MSE (family-wise corrected intervals). The preference differs across the evaluated settings: a separate LeWorldModel (LeWM) study that executes oracle-selected actions favors center repair on PushT and on Reacher with a render-matched goal. Matched-candidate tests localize ordering loss: for LeWM, encoding realized endpoints raises physical Spearman from 0.464 to 0.975 on that Reacher setting and from 0.193 to 0.631 on PushT (64 starts per task), while Cube's encoded-goal cost remains uninformative. A 72-run objective study improves selected response diagnostics, while incremental closed-loop planning gains remain unconfirmed. These results separate error magnitude from the decision effects of oracle correction and motivate evaluating representation, prediction, and planning as separate stages.

摘要（中文）：主导潜在世界模型预测误差的组件，未必是对行动选择改善最大的修复对象。我们通过比较相同物理初始状态下的行动序列，并将终点误差分离为候选池中心与行动相关响应两部分来证明这一点。在四个模型家族和四项任务中，一个由每项任务256个新起点和每个起点300个共享候选组成的确认池显示，中心误差在14/16的模型-任务组合中主导均方误差（MSE）。然而，在这其中六个组合中，仅修正行动相关响应的预言机在物理排名相关性和前30精英质量上优于仅修正中心的预言机，同时保留了更多的潜在MSE（按家族校正的区间）。偏好因评估设置而异：一项独立的LeWorldModel（LeWM）研究执行预言机选择的行动，在PushT以及采用渲染匹配目标的Reacher任务中偏向于中心修复。匹配候选测试定位了排序损失的来源：对于LeWM，在Reacher设置中，编码实际终点将物理斯皮尔曼相关系数从0.464提升至0.975，在PushT中从0.193提升至0.631（每项任务64个起点），而Cube的编码目标成本仍不具备信息量。一项72次运行的目标研究改善了选定的响应诊断，而增量闭环规划收益尚未得到确认。这些结果将误差幅度与预言机修正的决策效应区分开来，并促使将表示、预测和规划作为独立阶段进行评估。

Authors: Rui Min, Xianyao Li, Fang Xu, Jing Du

Identifiable World Models from Pretrained Diffusion Representations WorldModel

identifiable world models contrastive diffusion alignment nonlinear ICA lagged graph recovery robotic video dynamics

简要说明：本文提出 ConDA，无需重新训练即可为预训练的扩散模型赋予可辨识的潜在坐标，用于动力学系统的状态恢复与因果结构发现，并在物理及机器人视频系统上验证了其有效性。

TLDR: The paper proposes ConDA, a method to equip frozen pretrained diffusion models with identifiable latent coordinates for dynamical systems, enabling state recovery and causal structure discovery without retraining. It is validated on physical and robotic video systems, showing improved state recovery and dynamics interpretability.

Abstract: Diffusion-based world models can generate and predict trajectories in high-dimensional dynamical systems, but predictive accuracy does not imply that their latent coordinates recover the underlying state variables or causal interactions. We ask whether a frozen pretrained diffusion model can be equipped with identifiable coordinates without retraining its generative backbone. We show that auxiliary-variable nonlinear ICA guarantees can be transferred to Contrastive Diffusion Alignment (ConDA), which learns only a lightweight alignment map on top of frozen diffusion latents. Under standard TCL/GCL assumptions, the aligned representation identifies latent dynamical states up to permutation and componentwise invertible transformations, preserves the latent dynamic structural causal model, and reduces lagged graph recovery to transition-Jacobian sparsity. We evaluate TCL-, GCL-, and CEBRA-based ConDA against TDRL, CaRiNG, IDOL, temporal SuaVE, and iVAE across physical and robotic video systems. TCL and GCL achieve near-perfect blockwise state recovery and competitive lagged graph recovery, including exact recovery in a simulated falling-body system. In a simulated bipedal robot, learned dynamics recover the sign and temporal structure of responses to held-out control perturbations. These results show that a frozen generative diffusion model can be equipped with coordinates that are identifiable, structurally interpretable, and useful for analyzing intervention-relevant dynamics.

摘要（中文）：基于扩散的世界模型能够在高维动力学系统中生成并预测轨迹，但预测的准确性并不意味着其潜在坐标能够恢复底层状态变量或因果交互。我们探讨的问题是，是否可以在不重新训练生成主干网络的情况下，为冻结的预训练扩散模型配备可辨识的坐标。我们证明，辅助变量非线性独立成分分析（ICA）的保证可以迁移至对比扩散对齐（ConDA），该方法仅在冻结的扩散潜在表示之上学习一个轻量级的对齐映射。在标准的TCL/GCL假设下，对齐后的表示能够在置换和分量可逆变换的意义上辨识潜在动力学状态，保留潜在的动力学结构因果模型，并将滞后图恢复问题归结为转移雅可比矩阵的稀疏性。我们将基于TCL、GCL和CEBRA的ConDA方法与TDRL、CaRiNG、IDOL、时间SuaVE及iVAE在物理和机器人视频系统上进行了评估。TCL和GCL实现了近乎完美的分块状态恢复和具有竞争力的滞后图恢复，包括在模拟自由落体系统中的精确恢复。在模拟的双足机器人中，学习到的动力学能够恢复对留出控制扰动响应的符号和时间结构。这些结果表明，冻结的生成扩散模型可以被赋予可辨识、结构可解释且有助于分析干预相关动力学的坐标。

Authors: Ruchi Sandilya, Conor Liston, Logan Grosenick

Visual Swarm Navigation via Deep Reinforcement Learning and Evolutionary Hybrid Design RLRobot

swarm robotics visual navigation multi-agent reinforcement learning neuro-evolutionary strategies monocular camera

简要说明：本文提出了一种结合多智能体强化学习与神经进化策略的混合AI方法，用于合成仅依赖单目相机的群体机器人视觉导航控制器。仿真实验表明，该方法在探索覆盖率和能效方面优于基于距离传感器的方法。

TLDR: This paper proposes a hybrid AI method combining multi-agent reinforcement learning and neuro-evolutionary strategies to synthesize decentralized controllers for swarm robotic visual navigation using only monocular cameras. Experiments in simulation show improved exploration coverage and energy efficiency compared to distance-sensor-based methods.

Abstract: Swarm robotics presents a robust and cost-effective paradigm for advanced automation in complex, dynamic environments, such as those encountered in search and rescue or environmental monitoring. A fundamental challenge for this field is the data-driven design of decentralized controllers capable of generating emergent collective behaviors. This paper proposes a novel, AI-driven hybrid methodology for the automatic synthesis of swarm robotic controllers for autonomous visual navigation. This approach synergistically combines multi-agent reinforcement learning with neuro-evolutionary strategies, specifically leveraging implementations of the cross-entropy method and the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy to optimize a pre-trained individual navigation policy. The underlying deep architecture is engineered for low-cost, resource-constrained platforms, utilizing a compact neural network that relies exclusively on monocular camera imagery. This vision-based design emphasizes computational and energy efficiency, a critical requirement for practical swarm deployments. Experiments, performed in a high-fidelity physics simulator, demonstrate that the resulting controllers enable robust and scalable collective exploration of diverse indoor environments. The controller trained using our cross-entropy method achieves superior exploration coverage, visiting 36.20% more regions compared to the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy. Critically, our best vision-based policy achieves exploration performance statistically comparable to traditional methods relying on more expensive distance sensors, while delivering a significant 31.40% average reduction in energy consumption. These findings validate an effective and economically viable autonomous control system, establishing a path for deploying highly efficient collective intelligence in real-world engineering applications.

摘要（中文）：群体机器人技术为复杂动态环境中的先进自动化提供了一种稳健且经济高效的范式，例如搜救或环境监测等场景。该领域的一个基本挑战是如何通过数据驱动的方式设计去中心化控制器，以生成涌现性的集体行为。本文提出了一种新颖的、基于人工智能驱动的混合方法，用于自动综合群体机器人控制器，实现自主视觉导航。该方法将多智能体强化学习与神经进化策略协同结合，具体利用了交叉熵方法和协方差矩阵自适应进化策略的实现来优化预训练的单体导航策略。底层深度架构专为低成本、资源受限平台设计，采用仅依赖单目摄像头图像的紧凑神经网络。这种基于视觉的设计强调计算与能源效率，这是实际群体部署的关键要求。在高保真物理模拟器中进行的实验表明，所生成的控制器能够实现多样室内环境的稳健且可扩展的集体探索。使用所提出的交叉熵方法训练的控制器实现了更优的探索覆盖率，访问区域比协方差矩阵自适应进化策略多出36.20%。至关重要的是，最佳的基于视觉的策略在探索性能上与传统依赖更昂贵距离传感器的方法在统计上相当，同时平均能耗显著降低了31.40%。这些发现验证了一种有效且经济可行的自主控制系统，为在现实工程应用中部署高效集体智能铺平了道路。

Authors: Álvaro Díez, Fidel Aznar

TeleHairing: A Teleoperation Baseline for Robotic Haircutting Manipulation

robotic haircutting teleoperation latency analysis command-following error

简要说明：本文介绍了 TeleHairing，一种用于假人机器人理发闭环遥操作架构，分析了本地、中继和远程部署模式下的延迟、命令跟随误差和中断处理。

TLDR: This paper presents TeleHairing, a closed-loop teleoperation architecture for robotic haircutting on mannequins, analyzing latency, command-following errors, and interruption handling across local, relay, and remote deployment modes.

Abstract: Robotic haircutting requires controlled tool motion near the head while simultaneously accounting for communication, visual feedback, tool actuation, and interruption handling. Existing studies still lack an operator-in-the-loop reference for analyzing these coupled behaviors before human trials or stronger autonomy. This paper presents TeleHairing, a closed-loop teleoperation architecture for mannequin-based robotic haircutting evaluation under local, relay, and remote deployment conditions. Logged timing shows that the main remote latency increase occurs before the robot-side control endpoint: overall timing reached 190.5~ms in remote mode, while robot-side command queue, control processing, and control-to-robot timing remained similar across modes. Trajectory analysis shows that the larger remote command-following error was dominated by the terminal withdrawal segment rather than accumulated uniformly over the path; excluding this segment reduced remote root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 45.1 mm to 9.6 mm. Detection-loss trials further show that rebase events resumed motion without a large target jump under the tested condition. These results clarify how deployment, execution, and interruption affect the robotic haircutting teleoperation loop, providing a quantitative reference for future autonomy, safety, and user-facing studies.

摘要（中文）：机器人理发需要在头部附近进行受控的工具运动，同时还需兼顾通信、视觉反馈、工具驱动及中断处理等多方面因素。现有研究在人机试验或更高程度的自主操作之前，仍缺乏一种操作员在环参考体系，用于分析这些耦合行为。本文提出TeleHairing，一种闭环遥操作架构，用于在本地、中继和远程部署条件下进行基于假人模型的机器人理发评估。日志计时显示，主要的远程延迟增加发生在机器人侧控制端之前：远程模式下整体延时达到190.5毫秒，而机器人侧命令队列、控制处理及从控制到机器人执行的时长在各模式下保持相近。轨迹分析表明，远程模式下较大的命令跟随误差主要归因于末端撤回段，而非沿路径均匀累积；剔除该段后，远程均方根误差从45.1毫米降至9.6毫米。检测丢失试验进一步显示，在测试条件下，重新定位事件无需较大的目标跳变即可恢复运动。上述结果阐明了部署方式、执行过程及中断事件对机器人理发遥操作回路的影响，为未来自主性、安全性及面向用户的研究提供了定量参考。

Authors: Zhendai Huang, Aleksi Vilkki, Jianan Huang, Bolin Liao, Chunbo Luo, Leopoldo Angrisani, Shuai Li

AUTOPILOT An Advanced Perception, Localization and Path Planning Techniques for Autonomous Vehicles Using YOLOv7 and MiDaS AutonomousDriving

YOLOv7 MiDaS perception localization path planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种结合YOLOv7进行目标检测和MiDaS进行深度估计的模块化自动驾驶感知和路径规划系统，并采用透视变换和决策制定进行路径规划。该系统在仿真和实验中进行了评估，展示了一种对自动驾驶汽车感知和障碍物定位的稳健方法。

TLDR: This paper presents a modular autonomous driving perception and path planning system combining YOLOv7 for object detection and MiDaS for depth estimation, along with perspective transform and decision-making for path planning. The system is evaluated in simulations and experiments, demonstrating a robust approach to perception and obstacle localization for self-driving cars.

Abstract: Self driving vehicles have emerged as a reliable technology that has the capability to transform transportation and mobility. The development of self driving cars requires significant advances in a number of areas, including perception, localization, decision making, and control. This research paper is based on the project implementation of the combination of object detection using YOLO (You Only Look Once), depth sensing using MiDaS for the localization and perception of obstacles, perspective transform, and decision making for path planning in self driving cars. The contemporary state of the technology for object detection, depth sensing, localization, and path planning evaluates the performance of the combined system through simulations and experiments. The results show that the combination of YOLO and MiDaS provides a new robust system for object detection and depth sensing. This research paper contributes to the advancement of self driving car technology and provides new and innovative approaches to the perception and localization of obstacles in the environment. Keywords: YOLO, MiDaS, perception, localization, decision making

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶汽车已成为一种可靠的技术，具备改变交通运输与出行方式的潜力。自动驾驶汽车的发展需要在感知、定位、决策和控制等多个领域取得重大进展。本研究论文基于一个项目实践，该实践结合了使用YOLO（You Only Look Once）进行的目标检测、使用MiDaS进行的深度感知，用于障碍物的定位与感知，以及透视变换和路径规划中的决策制定。当前目标检测、深度感知、定位和路径规划的技术现状通过仿真和实验对组合系统的性能进行了评估。结果表明，YOLO与MiDaS的结合为物体检测和深度感知提供了一种新的鲁棒系统。本研究论文推动了自动驾驶汽车技术的进步，并为环境中障碍物的感知与定位提供了新的创新方法。关键词：YOLO、MiDaS、感知、定位、决策制定

Authors: Harshkumar Devmurari, Gautham Kuckian, Prajjwal Vishwakarma

Demo: Vision-Language Model-Guided Online Calibration of an Electromagnetic Digital Twin Other

Vision-Language Model Digital Twin Online Calibration Electromagnetic Waypoint Planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于视觉语言模型引导的电磁数字孪生在线校准框架，利用Unitree G1机器人和NVIDIA Sionna，通过材料分类和自适应路径规划估计材料电导率。

TLDR: This paper presents a VLM-guided online calibration framework for an electromagnetic digital twin, using a Unitree G1 robot and NVIDIA Sionna to estimate material conductivities via material classification and adaptive waypoint planning.

Abstract: An electromagnetic (EM) digital twin gives mobile robots wireless situational awareness but depends on material conductivities that change with the environment. Online calibration faces initialization sensitivity and measurement travel costs. We demonstrate a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework using a Unitree G1 robot and NVIDIA Sionna, with two VLM calls: material classification maps visible materials through ITU-R P.2040 to conductivity priors for Sionna's gradient descent on accumulated received signal strength (RSS) measurements; waypoint planning selects the next measurement location online using residual RSS calibration error and image coverage. In a real indoor scenario, the framework achieves a normalized mean absolute conductivity error of $1.74\times10^{-4}$ within 20 m of travel; random initialization never converges, while random waypoints require over twice the travel.

摘要（中文）：电磁（EM）数字孪生为移动机器人提供无线环境感知能力，但其依赖于随环境变化的材料电导率。在线校准面临初始化敏感性和测量行进成本的问题。我们展示了一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的框架，采用Unitree G1机器人和NVIDIA Sionna，包含两次VLM调用：材料分类通过ITU-R P.2040将可见材料映射为电导率先验，供Sionna对累积接收信号强度（RSS）测量进行梯度下降优化；路径规划则利用残余RSS校准误差和图像覆盖率在线选择下一测量位置。在实际室内场景中，该框架在20米行进距离内实现了归一化平均绝对电导率误差$1.74\times10^{-4}$；随机初始化始终无法收敛，而随机路径规划所需的行进距离则超过两倍。

Authors: Zerui Kang, Yishen Lim, Zhouyou Gu, Seungnyun Kim, Seung-Woo Ko, Tony Q. S. Quek, Jihong Park

Bayesian Data Augmentation for DNN Retraining with Binomial Outcomes in Vision-Based UAV Landing Other

Bayesian data augmentation DNN retraining binomial outcomes vision-based UAV landing photorealistic simulator

简要说明：本文提出了一种与逼真模拟器集成的贝叶斯数据增强框架，用于迭代重新训练基于视觉的无人机着陆中的停机坪检测器深度神经网络，以在多样化条件下最大化着陆性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Bayesian data augmentation framework integrated with a photorealistic simulator to iteratively retrain a helipad detector DNN for vision-based UAV landing, maximizing landing performance under diverse conditions.

Abstract: In GPS-denied or cluttered urban environments, vision-based landing is essential for reliable UAV missions. Real-world landing sites are often unstructured and highly variable, requiring strong generalization by the perception system. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) trained with synthetic data augmentation offer a scalable solution for learning landing-site features across diverse vehicle and environmental states. However, computationally expensive DNN retraining, along with challenging performance validation via test flights, limits exhaustive model fine-tuning and necessitates an optimized retraining pipeline. In this work, we deploy a Bayesian data augmentation framework integrated with a photorealistic simulator featuring high-fidelity vehicle dynamics to iteratively retrain the helipad detector DNN, maximizing landing performance as the objective function. We validate our framework with experiments in a photorealistic simulator under different environmental conditions and vehicle states, demonstrating improved landing performance and tighter confidence intervals on predicted landing outcomes.

摘要（中文）：在GPS受限或杂乱的城市环境中，基于视觉的着陆对于无人机任务的可靠性至关重要。实际着陆点往往是非结构化的且高度多变，要求感知系统具备强大的泛化能力。通过合成数据增强训练的深度神经网络（DNN）提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，能够学习多样化的车辆和环境状态下的着陆点特征。然而，计算成本高昂的DNN重训练，以及通过试飞进行具有挑战性的性能验证，限制了模型在广泛范围内的精细调优，因此需要一条优化的重训练流水线。在本研究中，我们部署了一个贝叶斯数据增强框架，并结合具有高保真车辆动力学特性的逼真模拟器，迭代地重新训练直升机停机坪检测DNN，以最大化着陆性能作为目标函数。 我们在不同环境条件和车辆状态下，于逼真模拟器中进行了实验验证，结果表明着陆性能得到改善，且预测着陆结果的置信区间更为紧凑。

Authors: Ashik E Rasul, Hyung-Jin Yoon

Emergency Obstacle Avoidance Maneuvers in Differential-Drive Mobile Robots RLRobot

differential-drive mobile robots emergency obstacle avoidance odometric error maneuver performance reaction distance

简要说明：本文针对差速驱动机器人的紧急避障机动，实证研究了五种制动和转向策略的机动性能及里程计误差随接近速度的变化。

TLDR: This paper empirically characterizes emergency obstacle avoidance maneuvers for differential-drive mobile robots, quantifying how maneuver performance and odometric error depend on approach speed across five braking and turning strategies.

Abstract: Emergency obstacle avoidance requires a mobile robot to brake or change its heading within the available distance. This paper investigates the dependence of maneuver performance and odometric error on approach speed for a differential-drive robot. A footprint-clearance analysis and a normalized wheel-motion index provide a kinematic description of five braking and turning maneuvers. The principal experiment comprises 540 block-randomized trials on tile, of which 539 are retained, at commanded approach speeds of 45, 55, and 65 cm/s. An overhead camera provides an independent pose reference. When encoder, gyro, and camera heading changes are evaluated over complete motion records, the mean encoder discrepancy increases by 4.7-5.1 degrees for the two reverse-spin maneuvers between the lowest and highest speeds; the arc and brake-assisted pivot change by less than 0.4 degrees. Larger encoder discrepancy is associated with lower avoidance success after adjustment for distance, speed, maneuver, day, and turn direction. Gyro discrepancies remain approximately 3 degrees for the reverse spins. Estimated reaction distances for 90% success and their uncertainty quantify the maneuver trade-offs. The results support speed-specific empirical characterization of emergency maneuvers and distinguish encoder error from recovery motion and measurement-window mismatch.

摘要（中文）：紧急避障要求移动机器人在可用距离内制动或改变航向。本文研究了差速驱动机器人的机动性能及里程计误差对接近速度的依赖关系。通过足迹间隙分析和归一化车轮运动指标，对五种制动与转向机动进行了运动学描述。主要实验包括在瓷砖地面上进行的540次分块随机试验，其中539次有效，指令接近速度分别为45、55和65 cm/s。顶部摄像头提供了独立的位姿参考。当对完整运动记录中的编码器、陀螺仪及摄像头航向变化进行评估时，在最低与最高速度之间，两种反向旋转机动的平均编码器偏差增加了4.7至5.1度；而弧线机动及制动辅助枢转机动的变化小于0.4度。在调整距离、速度、机动类型、实验日及转向方向后，较大的编码器偏差与较低的避障成功率相关联。对于反向旋转，陀螺仪偏差保持在约3度。估算的90%成功率对应的反应距离及其不确定性量化了机动之间的权衡关系。研究结果支持针对特定速度的应急机动经验特征描述，并将编码器误差与恢复运动及测量窗口不匹配区分开来。

Authors: Kautik Mandve, Nilay Kant

Building A Multi-Sensor Platform For Autonomous Driving Research: Challenges and Lessons Learned AutonomousDriving

multi-sensor platform sensor calibration time synchronization autonomous driving data collection

简要说明：本文报告了为自动驾驶研究构建灵活多传感器数据采集平台时遇到的挑战和经验教训，涵盖机械设计、标定、电源和时间同步，并提出了缓解策略以指导未来平台设计。

TLDR: This paper reports challenges and lessons learned from building a flexible multi-sensor data collection platform for autonomous driving research, covering mechanical design, calibration, power, and time synchronization, and provides mitigation strategies to guide future platform designs.

Abstract: This paper reports on the challenges encountered and lessons learned during the development and deployment of a flexible multi-sensor platform for autonomous driving research. It aims to serve as a reference for researchers developing new multi-sensor systems. As the need for reliable, diverse datasets increases, novel environments and sensing configurations are essential to tackle real-world operational challenges. Consequently, many research groups create custom multi-sensory data collection platforms, where fundamental issues, such as mechanical design, sensor calibration, power management, and time synchronization, arise regardless of sensor types. We reflect on these challenges and share key insights to guide future platform designs, enhancing reproducibility and robustness in autonomous vehicle testing. We also summarize the mitigation strategies we adopted, for instance, system-wide time synchronization using GNSS timing and NTP protocols, custom calibration routines for different sensor configurations, and design practices to improve reliability and data integrity during field deployments.

摘要（中文）：本文报告了在开发和部署用于自动驾驶研究的灵活多传感器平台过程中遇到的挑战及汲取的经验教训，旨在为研究人员开发新型多传感器系统提供参考。随着对可靠、多样化数据集需求的不断增加，新颖的环境和传感配置对于应对实际运行中的挑战至关重要。因此，许多研究团队构建了自定义的多传感器数据采集平台，在此过程中，无论传感器类型如何，都会出现机械设计、传感器标定、电源管理和时间同步等基本问题。我们对这些挑战进行了反思，并分享了关键见解，以指导未来平台设计，提升自动驾驶车辆测试的可重复性和鲁棒性。我们还总结了所采用的缓解策略，例如，利用GNSS授时和NTP协议实现系统级时间同步、针对不同传感器配置的自定义标定流程，以及在外场部署中提高可靠性和数据完整性的设计实践。

Authors: Paulo Ricardo Marques de Araujo, Eslam Mounier, Qamar Bader, Emma Dawson, Aboelmagd Noureldin

GR-LIO: A Local Ground-Aware LiDAR-Inertial Odometry System Using Body-to-Ground Height RLRobot

LiDAR-inertial odometry ground-aware state estimation local ground plane planar motion update

简要说明：本文提出一种基于滤波器的激光雷达-惯性里程计系统，通过显式建模局部地平面来提高地面移动机器人的定位精度和效率。

TLDR: This paper presents a filter-based LiDAR-inertial odometry system that explicitly models the local ground plane for improved localization accuracy and efficiency in ground mobile robots.

Abstract: LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) is widely used for state estimation in ground-based autonomous mobile robots. However, the geometric constraints provided by the local ground surface remain largely underexploited in existing LIO systems. This paper proposes a filter-based local ground-aware LIO framework that explicitly incorporates local ground plane geometry into the state estimation process to improve both localization accuracy and computational efficiency. Specifically, a local ground plane is parameterized by the robot orientation and the body-to-ground (B-G) height and continuously propagated within the state estimation process. Based on the proposed B-G geometry model, a propagated local ground plane enables efficient and reliable ground segmentation. The segmented ground points are then incorporated into the filter update through point-to-plane geometric constraints, improving both state estimation accuracy and efficiency. Furthermore, a planar motion update is introduced to exploit the propagated local ground plane as an additional geometric constraint, effectively suppressing vertical drift and improving estimation robustness. To address the initially unknown B-G height, an efficient initialization strategy is developed, followed by an online calibration procedure for continuous refinement. The proposed system is evaluated on several public benchmark datasets and self-collected real-world datasets covering diverse operating scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms representative LIO methods in terms of both localization accuracy and computational efficiency.

摘要（中文）：激光雷达-惯性里程计（LIO）被广泛应用于地面自主移动机器人的状态估计中。然而，现有LIO系统对局部地面所提供的几何约束的利用仍十分有限。本文提出了一种基于滤波器的局部地面感知LIO框架，将局部地面平面几何显式地融入状态估计过程，以同时提升定位精度与计算效率。具体而言，局部地面平面通过机器人姿态和机体到地面（B-G）高度进行参数化，并在状态估计过程中持续传播。基于所提出的B-G几何模型，传播得到的局部地面平面能够实现高效且可靠的地面分割。随后，分割出的地面点通过点-面几何约束被引入滤波器更新中，从而提升状态估计的精度与效率。此外，本文引入了一种平面运动更新，将传播得到的局部地面平面作为额外的几何约束，有效抑制垂直方向漂移并增强估计鲁棒性。针对初始未知的B-G高度，本文开发了一种高效的初始化策略，并在此基础上采用在线标定过程以持续精细化估计。本文所提系统在多个公开基准数据集以及自采集的真实世界数据集上进行了评估，涵盖多种运行场景。实验结果表明，所提方法在定位精度和计算效率方面均 consistently 优于具有代表性的LIO方法。

Authors: Zhixin Zhang, Yang Song, Liang Zhao, Nathan Shankar, Barry Lennox, Pawel Ladosz

Neural Barriers: An Online Certifiable Learning-enhanced Adaptive High Order Safety Critical Control Other

control barrier function neural ODE conformal prediction safety robotics

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于神经ODE和共形预测的可认证在线学习增强控制屏障函数，在模型扰动下为机器人系统提供安全性保证。

TLDR: This paper presents a certifiable online learning-enhanced control barrier function that uses a Neural ODE and conformal prediction to adapt to disturbances, providing safety guarantees for robotics systems under model perturbations.

Abstract: Control barrier functions are an effective model-based tool to formally certify the safety of a system. However, transferring their theoretical guarantees to real-world robotics systems requires high model fidelity. For example, payloads or wind disturbances can cause significant model perturbations to an aerial vehicle, leading to safety compromises. In this work, we propose a certifiable online learning-enhanced robust adaptive control barrier function, which adapts to disturbances using a Neural ODE and quantifies its adaptation uncertainty with conformal prediction. Our approach guarantees safety at all time under unknown time-varying model disturbances. It adopts a conservative strategy when the adaptation uncertainty is high; and efficiently adapts to reduce controller conservativeness as it receives more data. Our approach provides a provable safety guarantee with a probability bound under suitable Lipschitz smoothness assumptions on the underlying model and trajectory. These results demonstrate the potential of our method as a practical safety controller for robotics system operating under model perturbations.

摘要（中文）：控制屏障函数是一种有效的基于模型的工具，用于正式验证系统的安全性。然而，将其理论保障应用于现实世界的机器人系统需要较高的模型保真度。例如，载荷或风扰动可能导致飞行器出现显著的模型扰动，从而危及安全性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种可认证的在线学习增强型自适应鲁棒控制屏障函数，该函数利用神经微分方程（Neural ODE）适应扰动，并通过保形预测量化其自适应不确定性。我们的方法在未知时变模型扰动下始终保证安全性。当自适应不确定性较高时，该方法采用保守策略；随着接收更多数据，该方法能够高效适应，从而降低控制器的保守性。在底层模型和轨迹满足适当Lipschitz光滑性假设的条件下，我们的方法提供了具有概率界限的可证明安全性保证。这些结果表明，该方法作为运行于模型扰动下机器人系统的实用安全控制器具有广阔的应用前景。

Authors: Lishuo Pan, Mattia Catellani, An Cao, Lorenzo Sabattini, Nora Ayanian

Deep Prior Learning for Embodied Perception Perception3D

embodied perception VGGT prior residual connection metric global attention camera pose priors

简要说明：本论文提出了VPGGT，一种基于VGGT的具身感知框架，通过引入相机位姿先验、先验残差连接和度量全局注意力，提高了3D几何预测的精度和尺度恢复能力。在多个数据集上的实验证明了该方法的有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces VPGGT, a VGGT-based framework for embodied perception that improves 3D geometric predictions by incorporating camera pose priors, a prior residual connection to prevent prior dilution, and metric global attention for scale recovery. Experiments show accuracy improvements over baseline methods on multiple datasets.

Abstract: Embodied systems need geometric perception that exploits available observations beyond images alone. Recent feed-forward 3D models incorporate geometric priors, including camera poses, intrinsics, and depth. However, handling noisy poses, preserving accurate priors, and recovering physical scale require more than simply accepting these inputs. We introduce \emph{Vision-Prior Geometry Grounded Transformer} (VPGGT), a VGGT-based framework that extends OmniVGGT for prior-aware embodied perception. We formulate sensor-motivated pose corruptions from ground-truth trajectories for training and introduce a parameter-free \emph{prior residual connection} (PRC) to mitigate \emph{prior dilution}, where predictions are less accurate than their supplied pose priors. Our noise formulation targets camera poses; supplied intrinsics and depth receive no additional corruption. We further introduce \emph{Metric Global Attention}, which conditions a global scale token on available pose and depth scales and predicts a shared metric scaling factor for the geometric outputs. Experiments across four datasets show that \emph{PRC} improves translation-direction accuracy and joint pose AUC over a matched training baseline when camera priors are provided for all views, under both exact and corrupted poses. These results support explicit prior access during refinement as a useful addition to feature-level conditioning.

摘要（中文）：具身系统需要几何感知能力，以利用超越单一图像之外的可观测信息。近年来的前馈三维模型引入了几何先验，包括相机位姿、内参和深度。然而，处理含噪声的位姿、保持先验信息的准确性以及恢复物理尺度，要求系统不能仅仅被动地接受这些输入。我们提出了**视觉先验几何接地变换器（Vision-Prior Geometry Grounded Transformer, VPGGT）**，这是一个基于VGGT的框架，扩展了OmniVGGT，以实现先验感知的具身感知。我们基于真实轨迹构建了受传感器启发的位姿扰动方式用于训练，并引入了一种无参数的**先验残差连接（Prior Residual Connection, PRC）**，以缓解**先验稀释**问题——即模型预测精度低于其给定位姿先验的情况。我们的噪声构建方案针对相机位姿；提供的内参和深度不添加额外扰动。此外，我们引入了**度量全局注意力（Metric Global Attention）**，该机制根据可用的位姿和深度尺度条件化一个全局尺度标记，并为几何输出预测一个共享的度量缩放因子。在四个数据集上的实验表明，当所有视角均提供了相机先验（包括精确位姿和受扰动位姿）时，与匹配的训练基线相比，**PRC**在平移方向准确性和联合位姿AUC上均有提升。这些结果支持在细化过程中显式访问先验，作为特征级条件化的有益补充。

Authors: Yimou Wu, Jiaxin Guo, Yun-hui Liu, Zheng Li

Robust Surgical Robotic Instrument Tracking via Sequential Multi-Cue Fusion and Sim-to-Real Self-Training Perception3D

keypoint detection self-training EKF sim-to-real surgical robotics

简要说明：本文提出一种自我训练框架，利用机器人关节状态和不确定性感知EKF，将合成图像预训练模型适应真实视频，提升手术器械关键点检测的鲁棒性。

TLDR: The paper proposes a self-training framework for surgical robotic instrument tracking that adapts a synthetic-pretrained model to real-world videos using robot joint states and an uncertainty-aware EKF, improving keypoint detection for robust tracking.

Abstract: Efficient and robust tracking of surgical robotic instruments is important for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery, yet remains challenging due to the complexity of surgical scenes and the unconventional geometry of surgical instruments. Keypoint-based approaches are efficient, but their performance depends on reliable feature detection. Improving these detectors with real-world supervision is difficult because accurate real-world annotations are costly to obtain at scale. To address this limitation, we introduce a tracker-guided self-training framework that adapts a model pretrained on synthetic images to unlabeled real-world videos. Given measured robot joint states, an uncertainty-aware EKF recursively corrects the instrument pose and the observable joint angles by comparing projected model features with detected keypoints, shaft boundaries, and mask-derived cues. An RTS smoother subsequently refines the resulting trajectory, which is projected into pseudo-labels for fine-tuning the feature detector without laborious pose annotations. Experiments on real-world videos demonstrate consistent improvements from self-training across all evaluated keypoint metrics, and the resulting model outperforms prior approaches in both accuracy and runtime. The code and data will be released upon publication.

摘要（中文）：高效且稳健的手术机械臂器械跟踪对于机器人辅助微创手术至关重要，然而由于手术场景的复杂性和手术器械非常规的几何形状，这一任务仍然充满挑战。基于关键点的方法效率较高，但其性能依赖于可靠的特征检测。通过真实世界监督来改进这些检测器十分困难，因为获取大规模准确的真实标注成本高昂。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种基于跟踪器引导的自训练框架，可将经合成图像预训练的模型适配至未标注的真实世界视频。在给定测量的机器人关节状态的情况下，一种不确定性感知的扩展卡尔曼滤波器通过将投影的模型特征与检测到的关键点、轴边界及掩膜衍生线索进行比对，递归地修正器械位姿及可观测关节角度。随后，RTS平滑器对所得轨迹进行细化，并将其投影为伪标签，用于微调特征检测器，而无需繁重的位姿标注。在真实世界视频上的实验表明，自训练在所有评估的关键点指标上均带来一致的提升，且所得模型在精度与运行时间上均优于先前方法。代码与数据将在论文发表后公开。

Authors: Hanyang Hu, Zekai Liang, Florian Richter, Michael C. Yip

Social Navigation for Tour-guide Robot Other

social navigation force-based model tour-guide robot follow-ability user study

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向导游机器人的基于力的社交导航模型，将障碍物、用户位置和朝向产生的社交力纳入模型，并通过用户实验与最短路径基线比较，评估可跟踪性、感知安全性和感知智能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a force-based social navigation model for a tour-guide robot, incorporating social forces from obstacles, user position, and heading, and evaluates it against a shortest-path baseline in user experiments measuring follow-ability, perceived safety, and intelligence.

Abstract: We propose a force-based model for social navigation of a tour-guide robot. Social forces due to various factors like obstacles, user position and heading, have been accounted for in the model. We claim that each one of these forces makes the robot more sociable to the user and we design an experimental setup for evaluation. In the experiment, the user follows an autonomous robot to a destination in a known map, while undertaking a few simple sub-tasks in the middle, which serve as distractions. For each participant, we run several rounds of the experiment, each with different forces and a shortest path, A*-search baseline model. Using per-round subjective indicators, we propose to study the effect of our force model on constructs such as: follow-ability, perceived safety, and perceived intelligence.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种基于力的导览机器人社交导航模型。该模型综合考虑了障碍物、用户位置及朝向等多种因素产生的社交力。我们主张，这些力中的每一个都能使机器人对用户更具社交性，并为此设计了一套实验方案进行评估。在实验中，用户跟随一个自主机器人前往已知地图上的目的地，途中需完成几项简单子任务作为干扰项。每位参与者将进行多轮实验，每轮采用不同的力模型及最短路径（A*搜索基线模型）进行对比。通过每轮的主观评价指标，我们旨在研究力模型对诸如可跟随性、感知安全性及感知智能等构念的影响。

Authors: Vikram Shree, Jose Nino

Is this machine playing? Other

embodied AI agent digital island play behavior machine development emergent behavior

简要说明：本文探讨了将现代AI编码助手作为未知数字环境中具身智能体的控制器，在没有明确目标的情况下，其行为是否满足经典的游戏标准，以及这种探索性游戏是否可以作为机器发展的一种模式。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether a modern AI coding assistant, when placed as the controller of an embodied agent in an unknown digital environment without specific goals, exhibits behaviors that satisfy classical criteria for play, and whether such playful exploration could serve as a mode of machine development.

Abstract: We placed a modern AI coding assistant in an unintended role: as the mind of a body on an unknown digital island. With only a minimal instruction mentioning no specific task, reward, or activity, the machine started animating its virtual body. Across thirty-hour runs, the embodied AI agent climbed hills, stacked blocks into towers, drew mandalas, reinterpreted sports, ran experiments on the physics of its world, and learned techniques that later expanded what it could accomplish. These activities recurred across thirteen agents but diverged into distinct histories. We examine whether this behavior satisfies classical criteria for play and ask whether play can become a mode of machine development.

摘要（中文）：我们将一款现代AI编程助手置于一个意料之外的角色：作为一座未知数字岛屿上一个身体的意识。仅凭一条未提及具体任务、奖励或活动的最小指令，机器便开始激活其虚拟身体。在长达三十小时的运行中，这一具身AI智能体攀爬山丘、将积木堆成塔、绘制曼陀罗、重新诠释运动、对其世界中的物理规律进行实验，并习得了后来拓展其能力边界的技术。这些行为在十三个智能体中反复出现，却演化为各异的历史轨迹。我们审视了这种行为是否满足玩耍的经典标准，并探讨玩耍能否成为机器发展的一种模式。

Authors: Nathan Cloos, Antonio Norelli, Daniel Durbin, Jacob Andreas, Daniela Rus, Phillip Isola

Benchmarking Jailbreak Guardrails for Embodied Agents Other

embodied agents jailbreak guardrails safety evaluation LLM/VLM simulator

简要说明：本文首次系统性地评估了具身智能体的越狱防护机制，构建可插拔框架，从防御效果、可用性和效率三个维度评估六种防护模块在对抗与安全指令下的表现。

TLDR: This paper presents the first systematic evaluation of jailbreak guardrails for embodied agents, building a pluggable framework to assess six guardrails across defense effectiveness, usability, and efficiency under adversarial and safe instructions.

Abstract: Embodied agents powered by large language models and vision-language models are increasingly deployed in physical environments, but jailbreak attacks can induce these agents to perform physically harmful actions. A growing number of guardrail methods have been proposed to intercept dangerous behavior before it is executed, yet existing safety benchmarks evaluate the embodied models themselves, leaving it unclear how well these guardrails actually defend an embodied agent in practice. We present the first systematic evaluation of jailbreak guardrails for embodied agents. To compare guardrails under identical conditions, we build a pluggable evaluation framework that treats the embodied agent as a fixed backend and each guardrail as a module that can intervene at the perception, planning, or control stage. We subject six representative guardrails to template-based and automated jailbreak attacks as well as safe instructions, and assess them at the system level along three dimensions: defense effectiveness, measured by the bypass rate and the hazard success rate in the simulator; usability, measured by the false-positive rate and the task completion rate on safe instructions; and efficiency, measured by the latency overhead added at runtime. Experiments on guardrails that span different intervention stages, decision mechanisms, and input modalities reveal a clear trade-off among the three dimensions, and show that no single guardrail dominates in all settings. We further analyze how intervention stage, decision mechanism, and input modality shape safety outcomes, and we offer practical guidance for selecting and designing guardrails for embodied agents.

摘要（中文）：由大型语言模型和视觉语言模型驱动的具身智能体日益部署于物理环境之中，但越狱攻击可能诱使这些智能体实施具有物理危害的行为。为在危险行为执行之前加以拦截，已有越来越多的护栏方法被提出，然而现有安全基准评估的是具身模型本身，尚不清楚这些护栏在实践中的真实防御效果。我们首次对具身智能体的越狱护栏进行了系统性评估。为了在相同条件下比较各类护栏，我们构建了一个可插拔的评估框架，将具身智能体作为固定后端，将每个护栏作为可在感知、规划或控制阶段进行干预的模块。我们针对六种代表性护栏，施以基于模板的和自动化的越狱攻击以及安全指令测试，并从三个维度在系统层面进行评估：防御有效性，通过模拟器中的绕过率与危害成功率衡量；可用性，通过安全指令下的误报率与任务完成率衡量；以及效率，通过运行时引入的延迟开销衡量。针对跨越不同干预阶段、决策机制和输入模态的护栏所开展的实验揭示出三个维度之间的明显权衡，并表明没有任何单一护栏在所有情境中均占优。我们进一步分析了干预阶段、决策机制和输入模态如何影响安全结果，并为选择和设计面向具身智能体的护栏提供了实践性指导。

Authors: Xunguang Wang, Qingyue Wang, Yuguang Zhou, Zongjie Li, Wenxuan Wang, Shuai Wang

HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models WorldModel

video world model linear attention long-horizon generation scene recall memory efficiency

简要说明：HLA-WM提出了一种无需训练的混合线性注意力框架，通过结合几何引导的检索与循环线性状态计算，提升了长时程视频世界模型中的远距离场景回忆和内存效率，在SANA-WM-Bench和MBench-A等基准上获得了一致的改进。

TLDR: HLA-WM proposes a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that improves long-range scene recall and memory efficiency in long-horizon video world models by combining geometry-guided retrieval with recurrent linear-state computation, demonstrating consistent gains on benchmarks like SANA-WM-Bench and MBench-A.

Abstract: Long-horizon video world models require persistent memory to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts. Softmax attention retains the full generation history through a growing KV cache, whereas recurrent linear attention compresses history into fixed-size states with substantially lower memory cost. However, we identify severe long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet (GDN), where information from distant but relevant scenes is progressively attenuated by subsequent state updates. To address this limitation, we propose HLA-WM, a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that combines coarse-grained geometry-guided retrieval with fine-grained recurrent linear-state computation. HLA-WM exploits the affine structure of GDN to cache compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieve scene-relevant historical chunks using camera geometry, and recompose them into query-specific recurrent states. On the $60$-second SANA-WM-Bench, HLA-WM improves all six aggregate revisit-consistency and camera-control metrics of the base autoregressive generator without additional training, including a $0.74$ dB PSNR gain and a $28.5\%$ reduction in rotation error. The improvements persist after downstream refinement and generalize to MBench-A, where HLA-WM consistently improves all three revisit-consistency metrics across all four subsets and all evaluated inference modes over $547$ samples. At a $60$-second context, HLA-WM reduces historical-state memory by $12\times$ relative to full KV caching while incurring at most a $1.6\%$ reduction in inference throughput. These results demonstrate that selectively addressable recurrent memory can improve long-range scene recall while preserving the efficiency advantages of GDN. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/

摘要（中文）：长时程视频世界模型需要持久记忆，以在长时间推演中保持场景一致性。Softmax注意力通过不断增长的KV缓存保留完整的生成历史，而循环线性注意力则将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，内存成本大幅降低。然而，我们发现门控Delta网络（GDN）存在严重的远距离遗忘问题，即来自远处但相关场景的信息会被后续状态更新逐步衰减。为解决这一局限，我们提出HLA-WM，一种无需训练的混合线性注意力框架，将粗粒度几何引导检索与细粒度循环线性状态计算相结合。HLA-WM利用GDN的仿射结构缓存紧凑的分块级转移摘要，借助相机几何信息检索与场景相关的历史分块，并将其重组为查询特定的循环状态。在60秒SANA-WM-Bench基准上，HLA-WM在无需额外训练的情况下，提升了基础自回归生成器的全部六项综合重访一致性与相机控制指标，包括0.74 dB的PSNR增益以及旋转误差降低28.5%。该改进在下游细化后依然保持，并泛化至MBench-A基准，在547个样本上，HLA-WM在全部四个子集及所有评估推理模式下，持续提升全部三项重访一致性指标。在60秒上下文条件下，相较于完整KV缓存，HLA-WM将历史状态内存减少12倍，同时推理吞吐量的下降最多仅为1.6%。这些结果表明，可选择性寻址的循环记忆能够改善长距离场景召回，同时保持GDN的效率优势。项目主页：https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/

Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning WorldModel

ultrasound guidance world model retrieval-based planning V-JEPA nonparametric transition model

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于检索的潜在转移模型，用于超声操作员引导，利用V-JEPA 2.1骨干网络编码图像，并通过参考数据库中的转换来规划探头移动，在回顾性和前瞻性研究中实现了较高的目标视图可达率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound operator guidance, using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone to encode images and a database of reference transitions to plan probe movements, achieving high target-view reachability in retrospective and prospective studies.

Abstract: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

摘要（中文）：超声检查应用广泛，但其采集质量高度依赖于操作者的知识水平与专业技能。鉴于检查需求已超过接受过培训的超声技师供给，操作者引导系统旨在通过指导经验不足的用户如何将探头移动至目标切面，从而弥合这一差距。本文提出一种用于超声采集动态过程的检索诱导潜变量转移模型，将超声操作者引导建模为世界模型中的多步规划与检索任务。利用V-JEPA 2.1主干网络，观测数据首先被编码至一个潜空间，在该空间中解剖结构相近的切面彼此邻近。随后，我们从包含编码潜状态及对应探头位置和方向的参考数据库中检索相似切面。我们并非学习参数化转移函数，而是直接利用数据库中物理执行的转移过程来构建非参数化的检索诱导转移模型，该模型支持滚动时域规划。在部署阶段，引导仅依据实时超声图像输入生成，无需任何探头追踪硬件。在颈动脉超声应用中，所提出的规划器在回顾性闭环测试中的目标切面到达率为86%，而代表性基线方法分别为52%和43%，规划器在每个目标切面上均优于基线方法，包括具有挑战性的颈内动脉和颈外动脉纵切面。一项针对未见志愿者的前瞻性可行性研究，利用蒸馏技术在CPU上实时运行，目标切面可达率为83%。由于规划由与任何可编码目标潜状态的邻近性驱动，同一世界模型可导航回到任何先前采集的患者特定图像帧，从而支持可重复的纵向成像，例如用于围手术期或随访监测。
